dialog: Oh, that’s a relief… For a minute there, I thought I’d be late on our first day of renovations.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It looks like we need to be more prepared for the unexpected from here on.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Based on yesterday’s meeting, I believe he’s out today handling the permits at city hall.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Either way, we should be able to take care of everything ourselves!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let me handle the deliveries, Yuri. You can go and prepare the cabins the workers are staying at.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yuri… You’re getting distracted already… Try to make sure you fully check and count all the materials properly.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *ehem* Anyway, did we get an update on the number of workers moving in later today?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Will you be able to have everything prepped in time, Aiden? It seems like a lot to do…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you sure? I’m not much use in the kitchen…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, if it’ll help!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t have any plans until the workers arrive, and since Yuri’s got the deliveries covered…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sure, I don’t mind!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why don’t I give you a hand, Aiden? I’m sure it’ll make your job easier!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, I’ve seen you pull off even tighter deadlines. But I’m happy to make it easier on you today!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let me help you cook, Aiden! You sound like you could use an assistant chef!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can help you prep and cut up the ingredients to save you some time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s go then!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah… I’m fine, Aiden! Won’t you get cold like that though?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-So, what are we making today, and how can I help?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh wow… This seems like a lot to do… and you have to make thirty servings of this?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It really has been a while since I’ve helped out in the kitchen. I hope we can finish in time.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Right!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, I do try to help you out sometimes when my schedule is loose.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m not sure if I’m even helping though… I’m not as good of a cook as you are.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That stands for tomatoes, lettuce, and cheese, right…? I didn’t know we were making burgers today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess you do have a point… I mean, I know I have more fun with my job here at the camp, especially when the scouts are around.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahh, yeah… I remember!  That was when you were helping me earn my cooking badge.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, you were always so much better at it than I was.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You saw the stuff I cooked back then, and it was barely edible. That’s why I felt like cooking wasn’t for me to begin with.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, it’s not that I wasn’t interested anymore. I just thought it wasn’t my strongest suit.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You saw the stuff I cooked back then, and it was barely edible. That’s why I felt like cooking wasn’t for me to begin with.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d much rather have your cooking than mine!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ve always been so good at it, so I never needed to get any better.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah! I swear I didn’t mean to do that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, why would I need to when I have you around to cook for me~?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Your food is already the best, so there’s no way anyone could compete!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah! I swear I didn’t mean to do that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, I did struggle earning that cooking badge… but I had a lot of fun with you because of it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Come on, Yuri! I really need that cooking badge! Come and taste the food I made!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure I seasoned this one just right! You’ll see!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello! You don’t look familiar, are you a new scout?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, a friend of Mr. Andre is a friend of ours! My name’s Yoshinori!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Welcome to Camp Buddy! What’s your name?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Nice to meet you, Aiden! What are you doing over here all alone?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, I see… Well, they’re gonna take a while in there for sure! If you want, you can help me with my badge-earning activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m trying to earn my cooking badge today, and I could use another person to try out the food I made!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Since your dad is the chef here, then that means you should know a thing or two about cooking, right?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-Hey! You’re not off the hook! Aiden hasn’t agreed yet!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: D-Don’t listen to her, Aiden, I made a really yummy pizza back in the kitchen! If you come with me, I’ll let you have the whole thing!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sounds like you could use some pizza! It’s gonna be ooey-gooey with cheese too once I heat it up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you sure you really don’t want to come with us, Yuri? I can cook up another one for you, if you’d like!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-It’s not a date!!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *ehem* Anyway, the food’s waiting in the kitchen! Come on!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, a little warning, I don’t have a lot of experience cooking, so please don’t expect too much!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I did try my best making this food though! I used a recipe, but I made sure to add my own twist, and—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden…? Are you listening?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, really? That kinda surprises me, considering how good everything Mr. Andre makes here is!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! It’s ready!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Here’s the pizza I made! Fresh from the “meekrowahvé”!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah! Go ahead, try it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sooo, how is it? Good, right?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I sensed a bit of hesitation there… Don’t be shy, you can tell me what’s wrong!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aww, really? Where did I go wrong…? I followed the recipe exactly.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I actually used packaged dough from the freezer since I didn’t know how to make bread… And I didn’t know how to use the oven either…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-How about the taste though? I probably can’t get that wrong, right? It’s just pizza!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sort of… Some of the ingredients weren’t available, so I did a little bit of substituting…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I used ketchup for the sauce since it’s made of tomatoes, and I found some bleu cheese in the fridge, so I thought it would be fancy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Aww, man… I thought I would’ve been able to pull it off this time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks for being honest and giving me some tips, Aiden. You’re a really nice guy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re welcome! Since we’re friends now, just call me Yoshi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I guess I need more practice cooking… *sigh* So much for earning that badge…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh! I have an even better idea! How about you show me how to do it instead? Maybe I’ll learn faster that way!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re not doing anything against the rules, so I’m sure it’ll be fine, Aiden! Trust me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Besides, don’t you wanna use the kitchen here too?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Great, then show me how it’s done and let’s get that cooking badge!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Mmm… It smells so good!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Woooow!!! My mouth is watering just looking at it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you kidding? I can’t believe you made this in less than an hour! I was up all night making mine, hahaha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But you were using the whole kitchen like a pro! It was super cool!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I thought you’d never ask!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *munch*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: IT’S SO YUMMY!!! This is the best pizza I’ve ever tasted in my entire life!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m not! I never thought I’d like pineapples on my pizza!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, I’m sorry about that, Mr. Andre…! I was the one who invited Aiden to help me with my badge-earning activity!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey, Mr. Andre! How come you’ve never brought Aiden here before? He’s a really great guy, and his cooking is amazing, just like yours!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You should bring him more often, then! I’d be happy for him to tag along with me all day!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, how about enrolling him here as a scout, then? That would be so fun!! Don’t you think so, Aiden?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We can do all the activities together! We can go hiking, fishing, and you can teach me how to cook until I get my cooking badge!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: O-Oh…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I see… That’s a shame…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden is a really talented cook just like you are, Mr. Andre! Look, he made this really yummy pizza from scratch just a little while ago!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It really is too bad he can’t stay, then… I think he could really make a difference at the camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If only there was some way to have Aiden stay here…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There must be a way to have Aiden here at the camp. I’m sure he’d become, like, the best chef ever!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There must be a way to have Aiden here at the camp. He wouldn’t be alone back at home anymore, and we could have so much fun together!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, let me help too, Mr. Andre! I’m sure Sir Goro would love to have Aiden here too! Let me just grab Yuri, and we’ll go ask him right away!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It was worth it too! I’ve been able to eat all the delicious food you’ve made over the years, and it’s still the best I’ve ever had!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Aiden…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: L-Let’s just finish cooking! We have to finish before the workers arrive, and we’re getting distracted!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s great, Aiden! I’m sure the workers will go nuts over your cooking! I can tell how good it is just from the smell!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No problem! I’m just glad we managed to finish everything before the workers even arrived!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, speaking of, that’s my cue!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha… Maybe it is a good idea to have you both stay in here…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks, Aiden! I’ll bring the workers here soon for lunch so you can meet them too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …Just don’t forget to put on a shirt, okay?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whoa…! They weren’t kidding when they said they’d be sending thirty people here…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: How can I help, Yuri?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, Yuri. I’ll take it from here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello! Welcome to Camp Buddy! I’m Yoshinori Nagira, and I’m the one in charge of your move-in today! This is Yuri Nomoru, my fellow scoutmaster.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s amazing! We’re looking forward to working with you and making this place the best it can be!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Before we get into business, we’d like to invite you over for a lunch that we prepared. I know you all must be exhausted from the trip here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright! Yuri and I will help you to your cabins so you can drop off your belongings first!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ve prepared lodging for all your workers in some of our unused cabins, while you two can stay with us in our scoutmaster quarters, if that’s alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes! We’ve tried to keep all the spaces the same throughout the years to keep the classic feel of the place. I knew you would appreciate it, being an architect!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, right…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Though, I have to say, you must be a genius to be an architect at such an early age, Mr. Sirius!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wait… Really? I just thought that—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, I apologize, that’s not what I meant…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: U-Uh… I’m really sorry about this, but I’m confused… How do you guys know each other?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t wanna be rude, but… I did think something was oddly familiar about you both since we first met…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: GAH! I-I’m so sorry…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Umm…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: O-Oh!!! Now I remember! Little Lloyd and Serious Darius from the first term?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Would you look at that… Little Lloyd… I can’t believe it’s really you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now that I think about it… you still haven’t grown any taller since then… Not that it’s a bad thing!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aaah… This is so embarrassing… I-I’m so sorry, Darius. It’s just, you look nothing like I remember, and it didn’t even cross my mind that you’re the same person.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-We’re sorry about that, Lloyd! Either way, it’s really nice to have past members of Camp Buddy back here sharing their skills!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s kinda crazy how we’ve all come full circle and are sharing a common goal once again!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So will the new cabins be your main focus while you’re both here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s quite a lot… Is it really possible to build all of that in such a short amount of time?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes! It was my very first project when I started working here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For the most part, yeah…! It took a few years for it to actually be useable though.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course! We’re scheduled to give you a full tour of the camp after lunch!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And I think that covers all the locations around the camp! Did you guys see everything you wanted?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I understand. I’ll be around to help and supervise as needed.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright. If you need anything at all, you know where to find me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Uhh… Darius? Aren’t you gonna go with Lloyd?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… I see…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: O-Oh! Hey there, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Aah, well, I just finished giving Lloyd and Darius their tour. Lloyd just left for our cabin to do some work.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess you could say that… Today turned out to be a busy day.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden… You don’t have to force him to speak up…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I do remember seeing you with him sometimes whenever we were at the mess hall.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I guess I kinda didn’t know how to get close to him back then since everyone was calling him Serious Darius… I thought it was because he was a troublemaker or something…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: N-No you’re not, Darius! I understand now that you’re just a quiet person – I’m the one in the wrong for not trying to get to know you back then.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden! Don’t tease him like that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, I am! Just not when you do it to other people!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wh-Wha…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Anyway, I just want to say that I’m glad to get to know you better, Darius!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope we both can enjoy our time here at camp together this time around! It’s never too late to make friends, after all.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah… Did I say anything wrong…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ohh… I see… Darius is a really interesting guy, isn’t he?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, I guess you’re right, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I still have to write down a report for Sir Goro about everything that happened today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey, someone’s gotta do it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s not true, Aiden. You could do things like this too, if you tried!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden!!!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks, Aiden.  I appreciate the company.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there, Yuri! How was the orientation?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well… You had to tell them all about the camp rules and set them up in their cabins… It’s no wonder you’re tired.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s kind of exciting though, isn’t it? We’ve had such a quiet last couple of weeks so some hustle and bustle is fun for a change!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m tired, quite frankly… but I had to finish this report of everyone’s work today for Sir Goro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir! Yuri managed the deliveries, workers, and got everyone settled into their accommodations, while Aiden made sure they were all well fed.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Meanwhile, I handled the foremen and gave them a tour, and discussed their plans for the next few days.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve written down a full report for you on their plans, and you can see it on your desk when you get the chance!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, when we were discussing it with them, both Lloyd and Darius told us that they saw the opening was for work on Camp Buddy and signed up right away.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: They must have been excited to come back and help out here after the good times they spent in the past!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s great, sir! I have to admit, I was kind of nervous seeing all those people arrive today, but it sounds like we’ve got it all taken care of now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir! You can count on me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whew, it’s much quieter this morning.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I got up earlier than yesterday just in case something happened again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Lloyd and Darius were gone from our cabin already so I thought their work might’ve started for the day, but I guess not.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The specialists probably won’t arrive for a while too… Maybe I should go out for a morning patrol first…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Good morning, Lloyd and Darius!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What are you guys up to…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s alright! It smells good, actually!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, it’s nice you’re taking good care of your health! I usually chop wood in the morning to wake my muscles up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sure, I’ll let you know when I need it…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: During the summer term, yes! But, this time, I just wanted to be available in case anyone needs something.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… R-Really?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can imagine. You must be used to working with a lot of people to get a project done.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wh-What?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: N-No, I don’t recognize him at all.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let me go and talk to him!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning! I’m Yoshinori Nagira, a scoutmaster here at Camp Buddy. How can I help you?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! I assume Clermont Inc. sent you?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s a pleasure to meet you, uhh… Mr. Choi?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, and you can call me Yoshi!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Here with me are Architect Sirius and Foreman Najjar! They were also sent by Clermont Inc. to work on this expansion project!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, you’re actually quite early – almost everyone else is still in their cabins, so please don’t worry about it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Will you be staying here at camp for the span of this project too?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright! I hope you don’t mind sharing the same quarters I’m in though. All the other cabins have been occupied by the construction workers.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If that’s the case, shall we get you and your suitcases settled in? You must be tired from your trip.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, of course! Let me bring you to his office!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll go ahead, you two! Sorry to cut our conversation short!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Right this way, Jin!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning, sir! Mr. Hyunjin Choi just arrived. He’s the IT specialist scheduled for a meeting with you today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wow… This is probably the first time a new guy hasn’t been intimidated meeting you, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, it seems like you’re working on your people-handling skills!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We know it’s fairly outdated… and it runs pretty slow, so we barely touch it most days.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It does take a while to turn on… We usually just go to the internet café nearby if we need something done digitally.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: One of our tech-savvy scouts last term actually went there to upload a promotional video for our fundraising campaign.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well… We just thought we didn’t need it… since we’re an adventure-themed summer camp…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Gadgets are also banned from our daily activities…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… Thinking about it, we probably should’ve allowed devices.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It would’ve been much safer for the campers that way.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… I-I’m actually not sure why we don’t…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, but for a reason.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We try to encourage practical and survival skills in the more traditional way as much as possible.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, we want to set a good example for our scouts.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: More so, we believe it would go against the spirit of the camp, especially the social aspect of it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… And that would give me more time to do other important tasks…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Should we get you moved into our cabin now, Jin? Or get you some breakfast first, at least?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No problem. Is there anything I can help you with now?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That makes sense! To be honest, the most I’ve ever done with the computer is turn it on to read e-mails…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… I apologize. I’m probably going to be a lot to deal with when it comes to using computers – I barely know how the old one here works.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… So that’s what you’ve been carrying…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sure! Feel free to order me around to do whatever you like! I’m your personal slave for the day!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s awesome! After helping you, I’ve started to understand a little better how everything works!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you for taking so much time to teach me. The way you explained everything to me step by step made me realize how simple it actually was.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I do feel bad that it took us all afternoon though… You probably could’ve finished a lot faster if it weren’t for me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh no! And we worked all the way through lunch too! You must be starving!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, you don’t have to do that here! Our chef prepares three meals a day for everyone at camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We should really get you something to eat. Let’s head to the mess hall – dinner should be about ready!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, yes! The mess hall is usually full during mealtimes. It’s a bit more packed than usual since the workers for the project moved in yesterday!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, haha! Most of them are construction workers, so they do tend to be more fit.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope you’re not intimidated by them, everyone here is very friendly!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Huh? What’s the matter, Jin?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… That’s actually one of our scoutmasters… He’s in charge of food service and camp maintenance.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And about his attire… I forgot to tell you ahead of time, but he has this habit of wearing “less” to cool down from all his work…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As strange as it sounds, it’s actually quite normal around here…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden, how many times have we talked about this…? You knew there were new people coming today…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You could’ve at least put something on so you don’t catch our guests off guard.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden! Put your apron down!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This is Jin, he’s our new technology specialist. I was going to bring him here earlier, but we had to get to work first!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Aiden!!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *ehem* I apologize, Jin. Aiden is a very friendly person, and he can often be quite… physical as well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Aiden, can we just get something to eat? Jin hasn’t had a meal yet today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not in front of our salad, Aiden…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I’m so sorry about him, Jin.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *ehem* But as Aiden was saying, feel free to approach him if you need something as well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure Aiden doesn’t mind them! It’s what he likes doing after all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We actually used to have more staff a couple years ago to do these tasks.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thankfully, we’re planning to hire more people to help, starting next term.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, I know how difficult it must’ve been for Aiden to solo the past couple years. I wish I could’ve helped him more.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden is really skilled at anything he does! We honestly wouldn’t have made it this far without him.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But really, it never fails to amaze me just how much work you do around here compared to the rest of us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah, that’s actually what I’m in charge of! I usually engage the campers with activities and make sure their time here at camp is memorable and meaningful.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Before the workers arrived, there wasn’t much to do, even when I helped you with the chores.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s different from the work that I’m used to, but I’m just glad to be useful again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi, I thought you were over calling me that nickname!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Jin, this is Yoichi and Taiga. They’re scouts here, but they stayed on as full-time volunteers.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi! Where are your manners?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I’m so sorry about Yoichi’s behavior, Jin. He’s rather hostile when it comes to meeting strangers…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *ehem* Please give Jin some space to enjoy his meal properly, you two.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, Yoichi. If you’re still hungry, you’re welcome to join us.

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I didn’t give her an answer just yet…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s what got me thinking, Aiden. It seems like she was making a huge deal out of your department and using that as a way to take over.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She’s also expecting me to work with her at the same time…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I’m really looking forward to it! I finally made up my mind about what my role in this project really is!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure I can find a way to tell her as professionally as possible. What’s more important to me right now is taking the opportunity to help you.

dialog: You might have to start putting on more clothes, though. We can’t have her inspecting your butt too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha! That’s right!

dialog: And like I said, I’ll be staying by your side throughout this whole thing!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe… You’re the one bringing it out for me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course! Now come on, let’s get to sleep – we have a busy day tomorrow!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t think there’s anything wrong with the way Sir Goro has been leading the project so far… Are you sure you’re just not looking too much into it?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… understand.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… I’m not sure about this, Emilia…

dialog: I-It’s not that I don’t appreciate your offer, but I was trying to make a plan to resolve it myself…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well… I haven’t completely figured it out yet.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Can you at least give me a little time to think about what you’re proposing? It’s all very sudden, after all…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll keep that in mind, Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: R-Right. Goodnight, Emilia.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well… She did, and it really gave me something to think about.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: O-Oh, no sir, please you don’t have to do that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, for some reason, Emilia was trying to help clear up my role on this project.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir… She actually offered to work directly with me, too. But I didn’t give her an answer just yet.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think she genuinely wants to help me out, but that evaluation a while ago really seemed unnecessarily harsh.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That actually had me thinking, sir… If she had issues with the management, shouldn’t she have offered to work with you instead?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir… I did notice that as well.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And that’s why I held back on her offer in the first place.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I was thinking the same thing, sir…! After all, I realized I’m at my best when I’m working with you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… Well, I really don’t think I’m ready for that, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you so much for this opportunity, sir. It really cleared my mind about what my role in this project really is!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-It’s alright, sir! I can do it! I’m sure I can find a way to tell her as professionally as possible. What’s more important to me right now is the work we’ll do together.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have to say, sir… I’m actually glad that you’re moving in here with us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…! Really?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, that’s a good way to look at it, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir! I’ll do my best and stay by your side throughout the whole thing!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Goodnight, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Nnn… *stretches*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning too, guys!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, looks like everyone really does get up earlier than me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, I hope it wasn’t too difficult.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It looks like you’re doing something fun, though! Are you guys playing cards?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You... You can tell the future?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… that’s interesting. So that’s what you were talking about last night, too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m curious. What did Aiden’s reading say, Lloyd?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: T-That sounds really ominous… Is Aiden going to be alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s not call time for thirty more minutes. What’s going on?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Right.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Maybe we can move forward and discuss the specifics of the schedule?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, Emilia?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… Alright, then.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yeah.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sorry, but… Is… this what you really wanted to talk about…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, about that, Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I thought it would be best if I concentrate my efforts on the construction and staff management departments.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Since those do have the most room for improvement, as you said back in the meeting. Aiden could really use some help with the oversight.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-What…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia! That’s not—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, looks like you guys are done with breakfast.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, Yuri, it was nothing like that...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She was asking if I planned to accept her offer about working with her for the rest of the project.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, actually. I’ve already decided to focus on working with Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, let’s just say she was really expecting I’d say yes to her offer…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s give her the benefit of the doubt for now. We know at the very least that we all have the same common goal.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, yeah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry about it, Aiden. Like I said yesterday, I’m really looking forward to working with you for the rest of the project.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you worried about all the assignments you’ve been given?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t doubt yourself, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We rely on you a lot more than you think!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, Aiden! I’ll lead the way, and you follow!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll cover for you, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, Aiden! I’ll lead the way, and you follow!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know you can do it, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Especially since we’re gonna have each other backs!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah! You can count on me, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s what I’m here for, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If I’m always around, I’m sure we can work things out!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah! You can count on me, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For the next few weeks, Aiden and I worked side by side on our tasks.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I had been assigned to manage the construction team, while Aiden handled staff welfare and overall camp maintenance.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: With Emilia pushing a tight schedule, the construction moved forward at a very fast pace.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden and I didn’t hesitate to get our hands dirty, and we both learned a bunch of new things about construction from Darius and Lloyd.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone worked extra hard to meet the deadlines and we managed to accomplish every target Emilia set for us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Seeing the frameworks of the new cabins at the expansion site, we could already imagine how different the camp was going to look.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: While we were busy with our tasks, Jin spent many sleepless nights working on the technological goals of the project.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He relaunched our website, and included online enrollments and job applications.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: From what he explained, he also secured an internet connection and a security system for the camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Meanwhile, Sir Goro was swamped with legal work regarding the sponsorship, as usual.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Between that and processing all the new applications from the brand-new website, there was more work than ever.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thankfully, because Aiden and I were handling the construction team, Yuri was able to focus on assisting Sir Goro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Together they managed the project’s documentation, and each report sent to Emilia validated each department’s progress.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: On top of our other responsibilities, Aiden and I made sure that the camp was well-maintained and that the staff was properly cared for.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Almost all of our time was spent working, but I made sure to take advantage of our shared tasks and spend plenty of quality time with him.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We received many critiques from Emilia’s inspections, and she grew more and more frustrated.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I could see Aiden beginning to rethink his role at the camp from all the criticisms, and all I could do was try to have his back and reassure him.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As much as the work was physically exhausting, he kept smiling through everything, and it really encouraged me to keep doing my best.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Seeing Aiden happy with my company made it all worth it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You did great, Aiden! You were very professional, and everything you said came from the heart.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You didn’t need my help talking to Mr. Clermont after all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… It was only when I got the job here that I found out that you lost your dad…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So as soon as I knew the camp needed help, you were the first person to come to mind...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really glad you decided to accept.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, you’re already doing that, Aiden! But this time around, you'll get to help with something much bigger out there!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s why I’m really glad you made this decision, and see just how much potential you have, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was worried you’d miss out on this amazing chance.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning, Sir Goro! Sorry for the delay. Aiden just had to give Mr. Clermont a call.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Looks like we’re back to the grind again, huh?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, sir! We’re right behind you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good thing we expanded the camp… I don’t think we would’ve been able to accommodate everyone next term, if we hadn’t.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll keep updating you as usual if there are any issues in our department, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone proceeded to work for the rest of the winter, continuing where we left off with all the new goals set for us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thankfully, the weather didn’t act up for the rest of the season, letting Lloyd, Darius, and all the workers continuously make progress on the construction.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Jin was also able to finish the website and all the necessary tech integrations for the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t know how we would have been able to pull off all of these amazing changes if not for their expertise!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Meanwhile, Sir Goro kept the entire project well-managed, making sure we stayed on schedule.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thankfully, Yuri was there to assist him so he wasn’t as stressed with all the paperwork as he used to be!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden and I kept up our regular maintenance duties, but this time around we had Emilia doing most of the other chores like cleaning and laundry.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She would complain as usual, but she did the job well and got it done on time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All in all, it was amazing to see everyone work towards a common goal, all while enjoying our time together.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The days flew by, and we saw the fruits of our labor take shape as we came closer and closer to completion!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The snow started to thaw, and with spring just around the corner, we could clearly see how much progress we made!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t wait for the scouts to see how much this place has grown!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think that’s the last of it, right guys?

dialog: Goodbye, guys! It’s been a pleasure working with everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, I’ll help you out, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you excited for the first day of your culinary career?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ll be fine, Aiden. We have our phones to stay in touch!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I promise we’ll be fine, Aiden! Long distance is hard, but we can make it work.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I will miss you though, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You got your plane ticket ready, right? Your passport? IDs?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, great!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good luck, Aiden… I’ll be cheering for you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I love you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… Hell, but still fun…

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sorry…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden… Are you okay…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Huh…? Wh-What are you saying, Aiden…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really sorry, Aiden… I promise I’ll make it up to you… maybe you just need time to—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really sorry, Aiden, I wish I had more time. It’s really just the distance that’s been making things hard…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wh-What…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Aiden…! I-I’m sorry, please let me make this right!  I’ll drop everything I’m doing right now! Let me fight for us!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I understand, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You did great, Aiden! You were very professional, and everything you said came from the heart.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You didn’t need my help talking to Mr. Clermont after all!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden…

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really glad you decided to accept.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know it’s inexcusable, especially since I’m the only one you would’ve counted on.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …I’d say your best quality is the way you always hold your head high and look at things so positively.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, I love that about you just as much.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But in all seriousness, you never showed anyone a sign of what you had to go through.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not only were you always cheerful, but you were ready to help me and the camp out any way you could.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even when everyone left Camp Buddy after last year’s scandal, you were the only one who stuck around.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I honestly don’t know where I’d have ended up if you weren’t there for me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, I’m really thankful, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And now, with the choice you made, it’s going to last forever.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, Aiden… I’ll always be here for you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really proud of you, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hate to break it to you but you’re just gonna have to deal with me forever.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning, Sir Goro! Sorry for the delay. Aiden just had to give Mr. Clermont a call.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Aiden.

dialog: Looks like we’re back to the grind again, huh?

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ll keep updating you as usual if there are any issues in our department, sir.

dialog: Hehe, I love it when you take charge like that, Sir Goro. Reminds me of when we were scouts!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I mean it, though! It’s one thing to lead the scouts, but it takes a whole other level of skill to coordinate a project like this.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Did you ever expect Camp Buddy to blow up like this, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir! We’ll make sure everything gets done on time!

dialog: Yeah, to think that less than a year ago he wanted nothing to do with Camp Buddy, or us, anymore.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m so glad he was able to move past all of that!

dialog: Haha, me too. Now come on, let’s get started for the day!

dialog: D-Don’t listen to him, Jin… He’s just messing with you.

dialog: Sure, I—

dialog: That’s a good way to look at it, Emilia!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What matters is that you’ve chosen the right path and are doing the right thing.

dialog: H-Hey!

dialog: H-Hey! I-It’s not like that!

dialog: Oh, come on, Aiden! When are you ever gonna let that go?

dialog: *sigh* Can’t we get to work already?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: They say time flies when you’re having fun, and I’d say we had tons!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d say the same! I’ve never had someone that I’ve gotten as close with as you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t help it! I just have so much fun hanging out with you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You might not believe it, but things wouldn’t have been the same without you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Huh? What do you mean, Aiden?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wh-What…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I didn’t know, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If only I knew more, I could’ve done something to help.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I just never thought, after all this time together, that you were going through something like that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It won’t be, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m leaving to study now so I can be a scoutmaster here one day!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah! I know it’ll take a really long time, but once that happens, I’ll be right back here with you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Should we seal the deal then?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Here’s to both of us coming back here together someday!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Mnn…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *hugs tight*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, Aiden… Did I wake you up?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Me either… I wish we could stay like this forever…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, Aiden…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, Aiden. You don’t have to apologize…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everything you felt and said was totally valid. Stuff like that happens when we’re pushed to our limits, after all.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I mean, you saw how I was last term when we almost closed down the camp…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re all only human, Aiden. We’re allowed to have bad days every now and then; and it had been eating at you for so long, of course you lost control.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There’s nothing to be embarrassed about, Aiden… Showing your weakness doesn’t make you any less of a person.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It actually makes me see you as even stronger than I did before.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re someone who can light up a room. I can always count on you to cheer me up when I’m feeling overwhelmed.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Because of that, I can totally understand why you feel so frustrated when you’re in that sort of situation.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m just glad you trusted me enough to tell me all of that. It really means a lot to me, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: To know that you let me into the deepest and darkest thoughts you had, it really made me realize that you’re the one I want to fight for the most…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You know you can count on me. I really meant what I said to you last night…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But, even when you did, Aiden… I felt it in every single day we were together…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I felt how much you cared for me, and how happy you were with me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I love you too, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t know what held me back either… But all I know is I’ve always wanted to be there for you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And I don’t think we’ve missed out on anything together. I’ve gotten to hold you like this even when you weren’t my boyfriend.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ve done so much even without that label, though.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Guess you could call this entire trip our honeymoon then?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, don’t worry, Aiden. You didn’t mess it up at all – this entire time with you has been great.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope you’re ready, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Mmhh…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Aaah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe… That’s not what it was, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But what about the other nigh—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s just say you were a lot looser and relaxed then…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh boy, it did. It’s hard to forget that detail. You looked like you were having the best time.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Or it’s because you’re wearing nothing but your underwear. I can’t help but notice how cold it looks outside right now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha, did you really only just notice? It’s been like that since we woke up.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha! It’s such a shame we can’t do it back at camp since we started sharing rooms with everyone, huh?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Way to think ahead. I can’t wait to get back to camp either.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Anyway, it’s getting late... I wonder why nobody has called for us yet…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I doubt it. I don’t think the hotel would let us overstay, after all…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re probably right… Sir Goro does get a little frantic whenever it’s time to leave a place…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Should we go down to the lobby and check out just to be sure?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re not going out there in just our underwear, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, it looks like we got here just in time, everyone else seems to be here already.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm… It sounds pretty serious, though.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh hey, guys.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Got any idea what’s going on?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir. This is quite unexpected.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden, you alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know you wanted to go home…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you sure?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah! That’s one way to think of it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, everyone! Like Aiden said, he’s alright! It’s really no big deal!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Guys… Please be more sensitive to Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can’t just overwhelm him with questions like that.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *nods*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden and I actually talked it out last night.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure you all know Aiden’s not really used to being around all this luxury, so it made him feel a little out of place.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually… Since we’re all here… As much as I hate to talk about this, especially so early in the morning, maybe we should address it…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia’s attitude has been getting worse and worse to the point where it’s causing us major problems…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We can’t continue working with someone that keeps dragging us down either. Besides, Mr. Clermont mentioned replacing her at our last meeting too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… We can only give her so many chances. It’s just not going to work if she keeps refusing to get along.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But don’t get me wrong, I was really hoping she’d act a little better knowing she’d be in her element here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah. And on top of that, even though I warned her before we left for the trip, she still went out of her way to harass Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I just can’t let that stand.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve actually talked about it with her on multiple occasions too…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She never enjoyed her time at camp as a scout, so it doesn’t make sense why she’d accept coming back here in the first place…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: At first, I thought she was trying to be as professional as she could, or even genuinely wanted to help the camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But you’re right… It’s as if she’s forced herself to be here for some reason…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not only that… She makes unrelated comments to make it seem like she’s done some work while tearing us down.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri, didn’t you and Jin already do a background check on Emilia yesterday?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What about Emilia’s records, Sir Goro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why would an elite like her have the exact qualifications for a construction project then…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: To be fair, I don’t think any of us have one either…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But… does that mean we have to wait until we get back to camp?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If it helps, we’re doing this to clear our doubts about her.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wait… Can you look into that more, Jin?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s crazy… Are we sure this is the same Emilia…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I didn’t expect anything like this would come out of our search…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Shouldn’t we confirm this with Emilia first?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro’s right. And like I said, we have to at least hear Emilia’s side before we make any decisions.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll do it myself. It’s only fair that we give her the chance to defend herself.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please excuse me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s Yoshinori… Can I come in?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I need to talk to you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, I want to talk to you in private. It’s an urgent matter.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you would let me in, then I’ll explain.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: OPEN THIS DOOR, EMILIA!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll get straight to the point. You’ve done something seriously wrong that I can’t turn a blind eye to!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The show’s over, Emilia… We found out you’ve been lying to everyone this whole time…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You fabricated your application to get a job at Camp Buddy… And continued to lie about your status and your professional experience the entire project…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, answer me honestly, Emilia… Is that all true?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It doesn’t matter. Just answer my question.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m not leaving. Not until I hear the truth from you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Then explain to me why your parents are in prison and how you ended up losing everything!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You weren’t living the life the you’ve been making us believe you have!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, it is true…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: T-That’s not—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I don’t understand…! Why did you have to go as far as faking things just to come back to the camp?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why did you have to hide all of these things from us…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’d have understood if you had just told us the truth…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I never thought of you like that, Emilia…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And the only reason everyone else didn’t understand you is because you never tried to meet them halfway either!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please don’t think like that, Emilia…! It’s not—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia, I…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s not true, Emilia! Please, listen to me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… I’m sorry, Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, she didn’t…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She was so furious she even said she quits.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I felt bad forcing her to talk, and I even started to doubt if it was right to confront her to begin with…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… You’re right… She did open up about the reasons why she did those things at the very least…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And it made total sense for someone with a personality like hers in such a situation…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I guess what caught me off guard were the last things Emilia said to me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even after all these years, she still saw me as a friend, and she was right…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The moment the first scout term ended, I grew apart from everyone, including her…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know… But for someone like Emilia who struggled to socialize, or even have friends to begin with, I was her only option…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, when she lost everything that once defined her – her dignity, her past and her one friend – she had nowhere left to run back to…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And on the bright side, at least I understand her better now. I just hope I get the chance to talk to her when we get back to camp…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, it looks like the sky is clear, and I can see cars moving around outside so everything must’ve been resolved.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sure, that sounds exciting, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… I’m sorry. I kinda had trouble sleeping thinking about what happened yesterday with Emilia.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There were a couple of times I wanted to get up and check on her.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I really think the way I brought everything up with her just went wrong.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… At some point during our talk last night, she did say that… But I didn’t think she meant like this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: C-Calm down, Yuri… I don’t think she said that just to spite us…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well… She did at first. But since we had enough proof, she had no choice but to admit to everything…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She was really caught off guard that we found out about her secret, though… that really pushed her over her limit…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I really tried, but I don’t think she was ready at all to talk through and fix things…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right. We can’t just leave her behind.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll go to her room and fetch her! I’ll be right back!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia? Are you up?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s time for our trip back to camp, do you need help with your bags?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I know you said you quit… But can you at least come back with us to camp?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure I can help you with your situation, if you’d just let me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-huh…? The door is open…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-What happened to this place?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia?! Where are you?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *gasp*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia!! What happened?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…! First Aid…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Airway, check...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Pulse…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Check.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Phew… Thank goodness, you’re still breathing…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wait… T-There’s pills all over the floor… Emilia, what did you do…?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I need to get help!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hang in there, Emilia…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She wasn’t injured or struggling to breathe when I found her… So, let’s just hope everything is ok…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We understand…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, and I believe we can take care of her better at camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She really did lose everything she had, just like we found out in our search…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And from what I understand, she’s really been struggling ever since she began fending for herself.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: To her, Camp Buddy was the only choice she had left.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She lied her way back out of desperation not only for her survival but also to regain her pride…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… think the way I talked to her last night is what really pushed her over the edge…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia’s been fighting alone all this time… And coming back here was almost a cry for help that I didn’t realize…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: To her, I was still the only friend she made back then, and the fact that she couldn’t rely on me at her lowest point hurt her the most…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s almost as if I led her to do this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve never seen this much snow here before.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It looks like Lloyd and Darius are in a rush to check the expansion site.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Is everything alright h—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: WHOA!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Does that mean we’ll have to wait until spring to resume work?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wait… You two aren’t planning on working right now, are you?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I could help out! At least that's more manpower…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It looks like all the snow is still loose, so it shouldn’t be too hard to manually pile it up elsewhere.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… The problems just keep piling on top of each other.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, sir. We’ve overcome so many challenges before, and this won’t be any different.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure it’ll all be worth in the end, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure with Aiden taking care of her, she’ll get well in no time.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden has always been a kind and caring person. I’ve never seen him stay angry or hold grudges.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wh-What…? Me?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I didn’t know you were watching over us like that, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, we have room for one more, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha…! I was just joking, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess Aiden has started to rub off on me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-You’re just seeing things, sir…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t know what to say, sir… but I won’t deny it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’m sure she already knows… In fact, she probably would have been first one to notice.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s embarrassing that we were that noticeable, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’m sure she already knows… In fact, she probably would have been first one to notice.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re here. How’s Em—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia, I apologize for pushing you to talk last night…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What I said really upset you… And you were right about not being able to count on me as your friend.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This wouldn’t have happened if I had approached things in a better way…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But we really understand now why you ended up doing those things...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia… I’m really sorry to hear all that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This really is the first time we’ve seen you let your walls down, and I’m glad you trusted us enough to tell us how you honestly feel…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And it’s just like Yuri said, we’re here to help you out. Our doors were open to you then and they still are now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can’t give up now, Emilia… It’s not too late to make things right.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There’s obviously changes that need to be made, and we can only do so much to help you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The change has to come from you… I’m sure you’re tired of living in your old ways too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can do something about it, especially now that you have people to support you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know you’re a fighter, Emilia. And fighters don’t go down easily, no matter what!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just keep moving forward and never give up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really glad we were able to resolve things on a positive note, Emilia.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s a huge step for you, I’m sure. But I’m really proud that you’re off to a great start.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, I think we’ve bothered you enough! You keep resting and we’ll check on you again tomorrow, alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright then! I’ll see you two tomorrow!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-Hey! Was it really cringey…?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can go ahead too, Aiden. I just need to get something! I’ll catch up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello, everyone! Sorry for the delay!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, it was the opposite. She was really remorseful over the way she acted, and grateful over how we were taking care of her.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, that is our priority right now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… What if we let her stay?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re taking care of her until she gets back on her feet, but I think there’s more we can do to help.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hear me out on this… I know her true credentials don’t fit her original position, but maybe we can find something for her to work on.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She doesn’t have to be a scoutmaster to be able to help the camp out.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s not up for just me to decide, though…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Exactly.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, sir. That makes sense.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir! We’re trying to log down all of our memories from the very first camp term up until now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: They’re all going to appear on the website as a blog for interested scouts to read and find out what kind of experiences they’ll have here at Camp Buddy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, great! Let’s get started!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Glad you’re joining us for lunch today, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm… It smells like Aiden’s cooking…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Speaking of which, I don’t think I’ve seen him all morning.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll go check on him! Maybe I can help him finish up too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, I’ll be right back!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there, Aiden! I came to h—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: WHOA, AIDEN! What the heck are you wearing?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: J-Just an apron, you mean…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What if you get caught…? You know what happened last time Yuri found you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I won’t. But still…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden, your apron is untied. Be careful not to f—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sorry, Aiden…! Are you okay?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Mmhh…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sorry, I can’t help it…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I promise I’ll make it quick…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Tell me if I need to stop, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m going in, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: D-Does it feel good, Aiden…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll start moving now, alright…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: M-Me too, Aiden…!!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ahh… I didn’t mean to…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Me too…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, Aiden! I think that's the last of it ready to go!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hehe, yeah... We really did make a mess.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Wait, Aiden! You're not dressed yet!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Aiden, get back there!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah! Everyone, don’t look!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: T-T-That’s definitely just c-crum, I mean CREAM…! I-It got pretty messy in the kitchen!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah! Don’t get the wrong idea, everyone…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I think we’re done here! We still got lots of work left to do tomorrow!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Go to bed everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! Perfect timing! There they are!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, I figured it would be better as a surprise.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir. I figured we could really use the extra hands to get things done, so I called Yoichi and Taiga yesterday.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hehe, I figured it would be a lot more fun if everyone came along, so I invited them too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s alright! You guys are a huge help already!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, of course! Sorry for not introducing them right away, I got caught up with the reunion!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone, these are the new developers that Mr. Clermont hired to help with the expansion project!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This is Hyunjin, he’s in charge of the technology department!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: These two are Lloyd and Darius. They’re in charge of designing and building all the new facilities.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We have a team of construction workers too, but they’re on leave for a couple more days.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, she’s still at the cabin! She’s been taking care of one of our other crew. You guys will meet them later, as soon as they’re ready!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You boys are the best scouts a scoutmaster could ask for!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In all my years here, I’ve never seen a group of scouts that have the same sense of unity and camaraderie that you have for each other and the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s such an honor to know that you’re a true testament to what this place stands for!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All of you are truly living the ‘Buddy Oath’ to your core, just like a true scout!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Like the second Buddy Law states, ‘Always help a buddy in need!’ And by volunteering to come here today, you’ve truly fulfilled—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha, it looks like Sir Goro’s just as excited that the scouts are back and he just won’t admit it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just like how he was as a scoutmaster.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, Jin! I’d say having you here working with us counts!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We may be here at Camp Buddy for a different reason this time, but our experiences together will forever be a part of us, no matter where we are in life!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know you guys have been successful with your careers, but know that Camp Buddy’s doors are always open to welcome you back!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s make this a productive day, everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Looks like everyone’s divided into groups and working hard already!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: With all the extra help, we’ll be done in no time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there, guys! I hear Yoichi’s being a bit unruly again.

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you worried it'd be difficult to adjust and learn the new skills? Or is it about the environment, like back at the hotel?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you want, we can call Mr. Clermont right now and it’ll help clear your doubts!

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And besides, I’m sure I can find a way to see you every once in a while, and you—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know it may not be as ideal and comfortable as you wanted it to be, but… it’s for your own good!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Look, what I’m saying is, there’s a way we can solve what you’re worried about and achieve your dreams at the same time! A middle ground.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know it sounds overwhelming, but it'd be worth it in the end, I'm sure!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I understand why you’d be afraid of something like this, but I think it'll be worth it in the long run!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t let me be the reason you stop reaching for your dream!

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I’m only thinking of what’s best for you, Aiden!

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden… Where are you…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’m sorry, sir… I was just looking for Aiden… He ran off and I can’t find him…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We… had an argument a while ago, and he left before we could properly resolve it…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden was worried about the offer from Mr. Clermont, and everyone tried to give advice when they found out.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It only made him more anxious, so I tried to motivate him to accept it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But he ultimately decided not to take it, just because he’d be separated from Camp Buddy… and me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I wanted him to realize that he can finally achieve the dream he wanted for so long…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And that he shouldn’t turn it down just because he’s afraid of the future…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But the way I handled it only made things worse.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It just doesn’t make sense why he’d give up like that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve been with him long enough to know he’s the kind of person who always perseveres no matter what…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So why did something like this make him crumble?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …Yes, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wh-What…? I-I didn’t know that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I thought all along that Aiden stayed at Camp Buddy until his dad passed away.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can't believe I didn't know about this... How were they able to find work or a place to stay after they left with Andre being sick?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But the past shouldn’t affect his future... There must be a way I can still change his mind!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right. No matter my opinion, it's up to him to decide.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right... I need to support him no matter what choice he makes.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right… Aiden’s happiness is what matters the most!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m going to do whatever it takes for him!

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey, Aiden, I…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …I’m sorry about being so persistent earlier.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was so focused on trying to encourage you about the offer, even though I knew it was bothering you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It's not your fault, Aiden... I know how big of a decision this is for you…

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

dialog: Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: When we got separated, I lost touch with you completely…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Being far away doesn’t excuse the fact that I didn’t put in the effort to try and reconnect…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was wrapped up in my own goals, and just expected things to be the same when I came back.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even still… If I had only tried, then I would’ve known about what you had to go through…

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I understand why you kept that from me, though…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It was a difficult time for you, I can't even comprehend how much you both had to go through in the last few years...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’m sorry… I knew you were trying your best to lock those memories away…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s one thing that never changed about Mr. Andre…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aiden… I’m so sorry…

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No… I already promised I’d help Sir Goro with his admin tasks, so, I turned her down…

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s give her the benefit of the doubt for now. We know at the very least that we all have the same common goal.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, sorry. I was just thinking about how Emilia reacted back there.

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For the next few weeks, Sir Goro and I worked side by side on our tasks.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I was pretty shocked at how different and mentally taxing management could be.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But thankfully, Sir Goro didn’t lose patience and guided me every step of the way until I was able to adjust.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: With Emilia pushing a tight schedule, the construction moved forward at a very fast pace.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Occasionally, Sir Goro and I would help Lloyd and Darius with their department to accelerate the progress, not hesitating to get our hands dirty.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone worked extra hard to meet the deadlines and we managed to accomplish every target Emilia set for us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Seeing the frameworks of the new cabins at the expansion site, we could already imagine how different the camp was going to look.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In the evenings, we’d work with Jin towards the technological goals of the project. Sometimes even joining him in his sleepless nights.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We had to relaunch our website and keep it updated to cater for online enrollments and job applications.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: From what Jin explained, he also managed to secure an internet connection and a security system for the camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Meanwhile, Aiden was swamped with chores, as usual.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Between cooking, laundry, repairs, and cleaning for a horde of workers, there was more to do than ever before.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thankfully, because Sir Goro and I were handling most of the management, Yuri was able to focus on assisting Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m not exactly sure how helpful she’s been, knowing how distracted she could get when she’s around Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Although, I’m pretty guilty of being distracted sometimes too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ever since Sir Goro moved into our cabin, I started to see his more casual and playful side, which took some getting used to considering he’s my boss.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: On top of our other responsibilities, Sir Goro had me tag along to his meetings and appointments. With each one, I started to gain confidence and learn from him.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It made me realize how easy it is to take for granted how much serious, but not always exciting, work Sir Goro does behind the scenes outside of the camp…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: He never once complains about it though, and always get everything done without concern.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: As we had expected, there were times when Emilia would criticize the way Sir Goro had been running things, making her grow more and more frustrated.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I could see how Sir Goro was trying his best to control himself and stay focused on the task. The least I could do was always keep him company.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But even though our work could get overwhelming, he would always make sure we enjoyed the few peaceful moments we got to spend with just the two of us. It’s what encouraged me to keep doing my best.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Feeling closer to Sir Goro made it all worth it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope you understand, Mr. Clermont, but we’re more than satisfied with the state of Camp Buddy.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We also believe that it will allow us to maintain the spirit and quality of the camp better than we otherwise could.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I really appreciate your generosity, Mr. Clermont. Thank you for giving us a chance.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whew…! That’s done!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think we settled it in the best way possible, Goro. Now I’m glad it’ll finally be off your chest!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Like I told you, I’ll try and take over more things from now on! You don’t have to worry about a single thing!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think this is a good start if we’re really planning on easing the work away from you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, there’s not too much of that left! It’ll only take a few more months until we’re completely done!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* You must still be thinking you have to be responsible for everyone…

name: Yoshinori

name: Yoshinori
