name: Yoshinori
dialog: But now, you finally get to start over! And for real, this time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think everyone’s at the mess hall having breakfast. Maybe we should take the chance to talk before work begins today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We thought it would be best if we concentrated our efforts and made one perfect Camp Buddy.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you, everyone… I promise I’ll do my best!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri’s right, everyone. Instead, we should all be grateful for all the hard work and time Goro dedicated to the camp since we were scouts!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone proceeded to work for the rest of the winter, continuing where we left off with all the new goals set for us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thankfully, the weather didn’t act up for the rest of the season, letting Lloyd, Darius, and all the workers continuously make progress on the construction.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Jin was also able to finish the website and all the necessary tech integrations for the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t know how we would have been able to pull off all of these amazing changes if not for their expertise!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Meanwhile, Aiden kept up his regular maintenance duties, but this time around he had Emilia doing most of the other chores, like cleaning and laundry.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She would complain as usual, but she did the job well and got it done on time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Goro and I kept the entire project well-managed, making sure we stayed on schedule, while Yuri assisted us and Aiden’s department on the side.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All in all, it was amazing to see everyone work towards a common goal, all while enjoying our time together.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The days flew by, and we saw the fruits of our labor take shape as we came closer and closer to completion!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The snow started to thaw, and with spring just around the corner, we could clearly see how much progress we made!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I can’t wait for the scouts to see how much this place has grown!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Goodbye, guys! It’s been a pleasure working with everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank you, Goro. I’ll make you proud!

dialog: A-Ah, well… Honestly, we haven’t been able to do much together thanks to all the work.

dialog: Do you have your bike fully checked and tuned up? It’s going to be a long drive to where you’re going.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hold on…  I just realized… Aren’t we missing someone?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wah! What happened to you, Lloyd?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Here’s the cream, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, let’s start creaming!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Uhh... We might’ve squirted too much.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yeah, I was gonna say…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah, YURI! This is not what it looks like!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, at least here in the spa you don’t have to worry about getting burnt again, Lloyd!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We could grab something to eat over at the café!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wow, look at all these fancy-sounding drinks and desserts! They all look delicious, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We should enjoy that while it lasts! Haha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: How about a hotdog sandwich, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Bread rolls look good.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: How about that whole wheat baguette, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: How about some cream-filled donut holes!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I won’t…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Okay, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, maybe somewhere in the back…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro and I are actually here to grab a meal. I just happened to notice you were having a problem with the staff again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… It’s hard to think otherwise seeing you stressed out like this even though we’re on vacation.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In fact, I haven’t seen you hang out with anyone since we got here… Maybe you should try to join us and use this chance to get to know everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: N-No, Emilia. I was only trying to—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I just don’t understand… What are you getting out of this?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re pushing everyone away and letting all of us think that you hate us…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even if I tell you that’s not true, you wouldn’t believe me anyway.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I at least thought you’d feel a little ‘at-home’ with all of these fancy things around.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It really doesn’t make sense to me why you even chose to come back and work with us if you hate it so much…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: N-No, Emilia wait—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not again…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…! I didn’t realize you were there, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It looks like there’s no chance any of us can get along with her. She’s made up her mind that we’re all out to get her.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t think that was her intent… She’s had a lot of problems she had to deal with even back then.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hnghh... This wagon really needs some oil…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I should’ve dragged Aiden with me, he’d know what to do to fix this!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-Huh…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Are you alright, Emilia?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: N-No, I was just passing by and I heard you screaming on the phone…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Your phone, though… It’s broken… I can ask a scoutmaster to fix it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: N-No, that’s not—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: None of us know the whole story but I can understand a little why she acts like that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well... We never know what’s going on behind the scenes in people’s lives, so it’s best to give them the benefit of the doubt…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I agree…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, Sir Goro. Thanks.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why don’t we go and check on Jin?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Maybe we should check on what the others are doing?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello, Jin! We were coming to see if you’d gotten out into the hotel yet.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Aww, Jin! You know you’re supposed to wait a while to adjust before pulling out.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *ehem* Anyway, are you alright in here by yourself?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there, Jin!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope we didn’t bother you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you alright in here by yourself?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s fine! We needed to rest a little anyways!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, I remember that you enjoy the same stuff as Yuri. But is there something else that maybe… you know? We could do together?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wh-Wha?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-How about we do something with your computer, Jin?! You use that for fun too, right?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, I give up…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yeah! Why don’t we do that?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Umm… Sir Goro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well… I was waiting by the door until Ms. Vera walked out…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you okay…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I know it’s not my place, sir, but… if you need someone to talk to, I’m always here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I might have no experience as a camp leader, father, or a husband, but… I’ll try my best to listen and understand!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re your family too, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wah, really?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Umm… Yes! I need you to come to the mess hall with me, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ll see!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can open them now, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, but everyone worked hard on the decorations! And of course, Mr. Andre and Aiden cooked all the food!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, thank you, sir! If you didn’t build Camp Buddy, we wouldn’t have the greatest summer ever!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe… It’s really nothing, sir..

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you sure you don’t want to come with us and tour the hotel some?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Phew, today was jam-packed again!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, although I’m not sure how much more I’m up for, haha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m enjoying it just as much, sir! I never would’ve thought I’d be able to experience all this luxury in my life.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… I had to look up how much it cost to book this place, and honestly it’s nowhere near what I can afford.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, it was only because I was with you, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, already?! Time’s moved so fast the past few days…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m fine staying at Camp Buddy, sir! No need to go anywhere fancy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Take me back here, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think it’d be fun to drive around somewhere just exploring!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, we could even camp out, no need for fancy hotels!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’d be really exciting to travel the world with you, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I probably need to save a lot of money for that though.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-You don’t have to do that, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wait… What’s with all the luggage?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wow, and here I thought this trip couldn’t get any fancier.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Wait, did you say formal dinner, Yuri? I don’t think any of us packed appropriate clothing for something like this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This invitation says our reservation is an hour from now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe… I haven’t experienced anything like it before, so I’m counting on you to lead the way, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everywhere you look there’s gold and crystals… they’re almost blinding me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… Even if I’d known about this, I doubt anything in my wardrobe would be fitting for tonight!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… Thank you, sir. You look good as well…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-And you smell very nice too…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir. I thought it would match the style. It’s been a long time since I wore something this nice.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Business suits are one thing, but the last time I was in full formal wear was my prom.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But we do look good together, sir! Hahaha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there, Yuri and Aiden! You both look amazing too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This might be the first time I’ve seen you this covered up, though.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not really! We just got here too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, it’s a good thing you had something semi-formal… You still look nice nonetheless!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Maybe if you wipe that blank look and smile more you’d be less intimidating?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: By the way, aren’t we missing someone from your group…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, Jin. I’m sure all of us will have a good time tonight!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-You look stunning, Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Would you like me to call for the staff to take your feathers and purse? Just so you’d be more comfortable before our meal.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hush, Yuri…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Either way I think it’s gonna be quite the experience!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m guessing this is going to be a first for most of us, right?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks for explaining, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yuri…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You read my mind sir, I was just going to order whatever you did, hahaha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri, ssh..!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Calm down, Emilia. There’s nothing to get upset about.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: T-The portions are kinda small, aren’t they…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Mmm… It’s delicious! Your orders for us were perfect, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia, can we please just enjoy our dinner?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia, keep it down… The other tables are looking at us…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s not like that, Emilia. We’re not just following Sir Goro because he’s our leader.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re looking to him for his opinion because he has the skill and experience.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Enough, Emilia… We don’t have to talk about this… Not right now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia, stop!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir Goro, don’t let her get to you…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro, no!!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro, ENOUGH!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What were you thinking, sir?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir… You’re better than this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right, sir… Just take a deep breath…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro?? Are you in here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’ve been looking for you, sir… I couldn’t find you around the hotel…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir Goro? Are you alright…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I won’t go without you, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There’s no point, sir… I’m sure everyone’s already left…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m staying here with you, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But… you’re not okay, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You don’t have to be alone, sir… I’m here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can talk to me… I-I’ll listen...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I understand why you lost your patience, sir… All of us were feeling the same way…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What Emilia did back there was completely uncalled for… and you were only trying to stand up for all of us, just like you have before…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But none of what she said was true, sir. She was just desperate to defend herself like always, and can never admit when she’s wrong.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… didn’t realize that, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’m sure there’s a way for us to fix this, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What happened tonight was something none of us meant for, after all.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure Mr. Clermont will understand if we explain…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro… I know things aren’t going the way you planned…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ve gone through so much worse in the past and pulled through every single one…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know what’s hurting you right now is something else much deeper…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So please… tell me what it is…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: R-Redemption…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But all of us have changed, sir, including you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And everyone else knows that things are different now and won’t let this one incident define you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But you’re not who you used to be, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ve changed for the better, and nobody will let this one incident define you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t think of you that way, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In fact, I’ve never thought any less of you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And everyone else knows that things are different now and won’t let this one incident define you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I still look up to you, just like I did back then, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In fact, I’ve never thought any less of you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And everyone else knows that things are different now and won’t let this one incident define you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But you don’t have to go back to that, sir! I never expected you to stay the same, especially after everything you’ve been through…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You built a home for all of us, somewhere we could always return to, no matter what happened.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: None of the amazing experiences and memories would’ve been possible if it weren’t for you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And we wouldn’t have come this far if you hadn’t selflessly given yourself up for all of us…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s something that I will forever admire about you…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Your strength and resilience when facing even the toughest situations… Always giving your best unconditionally for the people you care for.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But you don’t have to keep bearing everything alone anymore… Everyone at Camp Buddy is here for you…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …and I’m here for you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re partners, aren’t we?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There you are, Sir Goro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone else has settled into their tents for the night, but…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …Yuri told me you came up here to answer a call?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-Is everything alright, sir…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope you don’t mind if I stay here with you…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What is…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’m so sorry, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sir Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Th-That’s not true, sir! What about Yuri?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And what about Camp Buddy?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’ve given me, Yuri, and everyone else here a place to belong that we never had before!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know we’ve only been together for the summer, but it’s the best one I’ve ever had!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Here I’ve finally been able to make new friends, unforgettable memories, and most importantly… meet you!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And for that, I’m forever grateful!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not everything is lost, sir…! We’re all a part of your family now, too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I’m not just your scout, sir! I’m your friend too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve seen how hard you work not only for the camp, but for your family too… All while keeping a smile on your face!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s why you’re my biggest inspiration, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Someday, I’m going to be a scoutmaster like you! A person that everyone can count on!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Then maybe you won’t have to do everything on your own, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know that’s a long time from now, but… when it happens, you can count on me to stay with you here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We have to make a promise!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: One day, I’ll be right back here, and we’ll be together again!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Partners?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Mnn…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *hugs tight*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, Sir Goro…! S-Sorry, did I wake you?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, sir… There’s nothing you need to apologize for…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This has been weighing on you for a long time and you were pushed to your limit…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: None of us would’ve been able to endure that for as long as you have, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But it only made me respect you even more, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For the longest time, you were someone all of us could count on no matter how tough things were…  always handling everything by yourself.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It takes courage to tear your walls down, and allow someone to see how you truly feel inside…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Knowing that you trust me enough to let me into your darkest thoughts... It really means a lot to me, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m glad you can count on me too, sir… We’re partners, after all.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I felt the same way too, Sir Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even back then, I already knew my feelings for you went way beyond admiration.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But… we were in such different times of our lives, so I knew I couldn’t pursue it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: After that, I closed off my feelings, just like you…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I guess what I’m trying to say is that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve always loved you, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right, sir… I can’t imagine we’d have been able to reach this point without going through everything we have the past few years together.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It feels so surreal hearing that from you, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ack… That’s going to be tough… I’ve gotten so used to calling you ‘Sir’ over the years… It’s almost like it’s part of your name too, haha.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yes, but that doesn’t mean I’ll stop looking up to you, sir— I mean… Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: C-Can I ask why…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, sir… I mean… Goro…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s going to take some time getting used to, but I’ll try… Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright then… from now on, I’ll call you Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This vacation has passed by so quickly… I didn’t even realize that we were going home today.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t think about that now… We still have the morning to enjoy together…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Nngk...! I-I think you’re squeezing too tightly, sir…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Goro…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* You’re way too strong…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Goro…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Mmhh…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Aaah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Nghh… S-Sorry I can’t help pack, Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Your size isn’t something anyone can get used to easily…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not right now… I could barely put my underwear on…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think that should be everything…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe, Yuri specifically asked me to make sure you had everything…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, it’s alright! We’re gonna go on more trips like this in the future, I’m sure!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, we are dating now, after all… Although I admit it’s still hard to wrap my head around being with my boss…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* For some reason, I felt like you were going to say something like that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: O-Oh!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: R-Right…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whew… That’s a relief…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wh-Whoa… There’s a huge crowd in here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Did something happen…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s covered in snow! I didn’t even notice that it stormed last night…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Unfortunately, that might be the case…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just let her be, guys. She might just get angrier.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll handle her, guys. Let me go and sort this out.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That might be a good idea… We need to know what’s going on too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And her disrespecting the staff isn’t going to get us any answers…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm… I guess we should.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Right… We aren’t even sure how long we’ll be stuck.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Me neither… We were so busy pampering ourselves that we forgot what was happening in the outside world.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess what we talked about this morning came true, huh?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There’s not much we can do until the snow is gone, though…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah! That’s a good way to put it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All of us look up to you, and we’re just happy you’re alright now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-It was really nothing, hehe…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right, Goro… There’s no denying that she’s been causing us major problems in and out of the workplace…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We can’t just continue working with someone that keeps dragging us down either. Besides, Mr. Clermont mentioned replacing her on our last meeting too.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… We can only give her so many chances. It’s just not going to work if she keeps refusing to get along.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But don’t get me wrong, I was really hoping she’d act a little better knowing she’d be in her element here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah. And on top of that, even though I warned her before we left for the trip, she still went out of her way to insult Sir Goro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I just can’t let that stand.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She never enjoyed her time at camp as a scout, so it doesn’t make sense why she’d accept coming back here in the first place…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: At first, I thought she was trying to be as professional as she could, or even genuinely wanted to help the camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But you’re right… It’s as if she’s forced herself to be here for some reason…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Not only that… She makes unrelated comments to make it seem like she’s done some work while tearing us down.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why would an elite like her have the exact qualifications for a construction project then…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: To be fair, I don’t think any of us have one either…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But… does that mean we have to wait until we get back to camp?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If it helps, we’re doing this to clear our doubts about her.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wait… Can you look into that more, Jin?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s crazy… Are we sure this is the same Emilia…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I didn’t expect anything like this would come out of our search…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Shouldn’t we confirm this with Emilia first?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Goro’s right. And like I said, we have to at least hear Emilia’s side before we make any decisions.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll do it myself. It’s only fair that we give her the chance to defend herself.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please excuse me.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s Yoshinori… Can I come in?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I need to talk to you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: No, I want to talk to you in private. It’s an urgent matter.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: If you would let me in, then I’ll explain.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: OPEN THIS DOOR, EMILIA!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll get straight to the point. You’ve done something seriously wrong that I can’t turn a blind eye to!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The show’s over, Emilia… We found out you’ve been lying to everyone this whole time…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You fabricated your application to get a job at Camp Buddy… And continued to lie about your status and your professional experience the entire project…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, answer me honestly, Emilia… Is that all true?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It doesn’t matter. Just answer my question.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m not leaving. Not until I hear the truth from you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Then explain to me why your parents are in prison and how you ended up losing everything!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You weren’t living the life the you’ve been making us believe you have!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, it is true…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: T-That’s not—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I don’t understand…! Why did you have to go as far as faking things just to come back to the camp?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why did you have to hide all of these things from us…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’d have understood if you had just told us the truth…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I never thought of you like that, Emilia…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And the only reason everyone else didn’t understand you is because you never tried to meet them halfway either!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Please don’t think like that, Emilia…! It’s not—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia, I…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s not true, Emilia! Please, listen to me!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… I’m sorry, Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah, Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, she didn’t…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She was so furious she even said she quits.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I felt bad forcing her to talk, and I even started to doubt if it was right to confront her to begin with…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… You’re right… She did open up about the reasons why she did those things at the very least…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And it made total sense for someone with a personality like hers in such a situation…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But I guess what caught me off guard were the last things Emilia said to me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even after all these years, she still saw me as a friend, and she was right…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: The moment the first scout term ended, I grew apart from everyone, including her…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know… But for someone like Emilia who struggled to socialize, or even have friends to begin with, I was her only option…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: So, when she lost everything that once defined her – her dignity, her past and her one friend – she had nowhere left to run back to…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You’re right, Goro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And on the bright side, at least I understand her better now. I just hope I get the chance to talk to her when we get back to camp...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Right…! Good night, Goro.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Looks like the cleanup outside is done, the sky’s clear and I can see shuttles arriving, – we can finally go home.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m a little surprised, from the sound of things yesterday I thought we’d be here longer, but it did have to end eventually.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And either way, I did enjoy our trip here! W-Well… at least the first parts of it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m going to be honest… I had a bit of trouble sleeping last night thinking about what happened yesterday with Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: There were a couple of times I wanted to get up and check on her… but it was really late.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I really think the way I brought everything up to her went wrong at some point.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah… At some point during our talk last night, she did say that… But I didn’t think she meant like this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: C-Calm down, Yuri… I don’t think she said that just to spite us…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well… She did at first. But since we had enough proof, she had no choice but to admit to everything…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She was really caught off guard that we found out about her secret, though… that really pushed her over her limit…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I really tried, but I don’t think she was ready at all to talk through and fix things…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s right. We can’t just leave her behind.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ll go to her room and fetch her! I’ll be right back!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia? Are you up?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s time for our trip back to camp, do you need help with your bags?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I know you said you quit… But can you at least come back with us to camp?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure I can help you with your situation, if you’d just let me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-huh…? The door is open…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-What happened to this place?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia?! Where are you?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *gasp*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia!! What happened?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…! First Aid…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Airway, check...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Pulse…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Check.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Phew… Thank goodness, you’re still breathing…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wait… T-There’s pills all over the floor… Emilia, what did you do…?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I need to get help!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hang in there, Emilia…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She wasn’t injured or struggling to breathe when I found her… So, let’s just hope everything is ok…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We understand…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, and I believe we can take care of her better at camp.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She really did lose everything she had, just like we found out in our search…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And from what I understand, she’s really been struggling ever since she began fending for herself.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: To her, Camp Buddy was the only choice she had left.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She lied her way back out of desperation not only for her survival but also to regain her pride…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… think the way I talked to her last night is what really pushed her over the edge…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia’s been fighting alone all this time… And coming back here was almost a cry for help that I didn’t realize…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: To her, I was still the only friend she made back then, and the fact that she couldn’t rely on me at her lowest point hurt her the most…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s almost as if I led her to do this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’ve never seen this much snow here before.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It looks like Lloyd and Darius are in a rush to check the expansion site.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s catch up with them.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Is everything alright h—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: WHOA!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This was actually what Sir Goro was afraid of when we were scheduling work around the winter time…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Snowstorms happen here at least once a year, but this was way worse than usual…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thank goodness, we were away from camp when this happened. It would’ve been really dangerous for everyone.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Something like that would make us miss our target for sure…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This isn’t anyone’s fault. None of us could’ve anticipated a storm like this.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… The news did say we’d have clear weather for the next few days. Maybe we can work, as long as we’re careful?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I could help out! At least that's more manpower…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course. We do this every year anyways.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Besides, it looks like all the snow here is still loose, so it shouldn’t be too hard to pile it up somewhere else.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… The problems just keep coming one on top of another…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, Aiden. We’ve overcome so many challenges before, and this won’t be any different.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Thanks, Aiden. I’m sure it’ll all be worth it in the end.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We just have to do our best to keep things under control and get our momentum back.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: For now, I trust Goro’s judgment on how to handle the situation with Mr. Clermont.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmmm… I know the hotel staff informed him about us being stuck at the hotel, but I think that’s all he knows so far.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m sure he’ll want to report about the site condition once he finds out at least.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Goro told me on our way back he’ll let Emilia recover first before we address the situation with her.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah… He’s been trying to be more understanding and forgiving than he was before.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m glad you noticed his efforts, Aiden. He’s had a hard time trying to adjust to all of this at once.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Huh? What do you mean?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wh-What are you trying to say, Aiden…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, you could call him Goro too, if you wanted.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’m not sure if he’d like that though.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I don’t know where we’re going with this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: D-Don’t get the wrong idea, Aiden… I’m not trying to be disrespectful to him, he’s still our camp president!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I don’t know where we’re going with this…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay… you got me…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahh… I’m not sure how she’ll take that… Surprisingly, it doesn’t look like she’s noticed anything at all…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah…! Don’t say something like that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sure, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-He likes it that way, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahh… I’m not sure how she’ll take that… Surprisingly, it doesn’t look like she’s noticed anything at all…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah…! Don’t say something like that!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sure, Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, Aiden.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re here. How’s Em—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia, I apologize for pushing you to talk last night…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What I said really upset you… And you were right about not being able to count on me as your friend.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This wouldn’t have happened if I had approached things in a better way…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But we really understand now why you ended up doing those things...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia… I’m really sorry to hear all that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This really is the first time we’ve seen you let your walls down, and I’m glad you trusted us enough to tell us how you honestly feel…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And it’s just like Yuri said, we’re here to help you out. Our doors were open to you then and they still are now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I can’t believe that worked…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah. Try and rest for now, Emilia.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: And if you feel like you need professional help, just tell us, alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m really glad we were able to resolve things on a positive note, Emilia.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s a huge step for you, I’m sure. But I’m really proud that you’re off to a great start.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Now, I think we’ve bothered you enough! You keep resting and we’ll check on you again tomorrow, alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That was a really amazing speech you gave there, Goro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-Hey…! That’s not a bad thing, is it…?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You can go ahead too, Aiden. I just need to get something! I’ll catch up!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello, sorry for the delay!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Actually, it was the opposite. She was really remorseful over the way she acted, and grateful over how we were taking care of her.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yes, that is our priority right now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well… What if we let her stay?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’re taking care of her until she gets back on her feet, but I think there’s more we can do to help.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hear me out on this… I know her true credentials don’t fit her original position, but maybe we can find something for her to work on.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: She doesn’t have to be a scoutmaster to be able to help the camp out.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s not up for just me to decide, though…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Exactly.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Of course, Goro. That makes sense.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Th-Thank you, Goro…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Th-The way you say it…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah! And they’re all going to appear on the website as a blog that interested scouts can read and find out what sorts of experiences they’ll have here at Camp Buddy!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Okay, great! Let’s get started!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good morning, sir!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I brought you your morning coffee before we started work today! I figured-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Huh?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmmm… That’s odd. Sir Goro is always awake this time of day. I wonder if he overslept?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hehe… Maybe I can catch him snoring… Yuri always mentions he’s a heavy sleeper.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh! His door is even unlocked.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Huh?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *huff* *huff* I-I can’t believe I did that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: My shirt is all sticky too… I didn’t have a chance to-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh no! I-It got all over the door!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I have to go back there and clean it quick-

name: Yoshinori
dialog: GAH! Sir Goro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: N-No sir! Not at all! I-I was just heading to get you for our chores…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: NO! I just got here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: OH! I just remembered, I promised Aiden I’d help him in the garden this morning!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sorry sir, I’ll come back again- I mean, I gotta go!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Guys, that sounds a lot worse than it was…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I-I’m sure Jin has enough story for now, so let’s go to bed!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah! Come on, guys! That’s enough!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah! Perfect timing! There they are!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, I figured it would be better as a surprise.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah. I figured we could really use the extra hands to get things done, so I called Yoichi and Taiga yesterday.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hehe, I figured it would be a lot more fun if everyone came along, so I invited them too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s alright! You guys are a huge help already!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, of course! Sorry for not introducing them right away, I got caught up with the reunion!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Everyone, these are the new developers that Mr. Clermont hired to help with the expansion project!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: This is Hyunjin, he’s in charge of the technology department!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: These two are Lloyd and Darius. They’re in charge of designing and building all the new facilities.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We have a team of construction workers too, but they’re on leave for a couple more days.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, she’s still at the cabin! She’s been taking care of one of our other crew. You guys will meet them later, as soon as they’re ready!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You boys are the best scouts a scoutmaster could ask for!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In all my years here, I’ve never seen a group of scouts that have the same sense of unity and camaraderie that you have for each other and the camp!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s such an honor to know that you’re a true testament to what this place stands for!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: All of you are truly living the ‘Buddy Oath’ to your core, just like a true scout!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Like the second Buddy Law states, ‘Always help a buddy in need!’ And by volunteering to come here today, you’ve truly fulfilled—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha, it looks like Sir Goro’s just as excited that the scouts are back and he just won’t admit it.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Just like how he was as a scoutmaster.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Don’t worry, Jin! I’d say having you here working with us counts!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We may be here at Camp Buddy for a different reason this time, but our experiences together will forever be a part of us, no matter where we are in life!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know you guys have been successful with your careers, but know that Camp Buddy’s doors are always open to welcome you back!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s make this a productive day, everyone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Looks like everyone’s divided into groups and working hard already!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: With all the extra help, we’ll be done in no time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there, guys! I hear Yoichi’s being a bit unruly again.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, Natsumi is officially the best scout we have, and for three terms in a row now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: In my entire time at the camp, nobody else has earned more badges than him!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s always been great to see you share your hobbies with us, Lloyd! This entire project wouldn’t be as fun without them.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s alright, things happen! We just have to make the best of it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, that reminds me, I should probably check on the other group too. There was quite a bit more snow over there…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you all okay here if I leave for now?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s see…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there, guys! How’s everything going here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I think this is the first time in a while that you’ve done a hands-on activity with the scouts, isn’t it, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But it’s understandable, sir. You were dealing with a lot of things behind the scenes.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hahaha! You’re not really used to the compliments, huh sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It baffles me how out of touch I am with modern times, that even something like games can be used as a business…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Looks like time has taken its toll on us, huh, sir?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s why Jin’s here to bring us up to date!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey, everyone! Why don’t we take a break?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Either way, you scouts helping out is already a huge boost! We managed to clear out a huge chunk of ice and snow in a short time!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ah, Yuri’s watching over Emilia, our inspector… sort of.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah. But don’t worry, she’s doing a lot better now and just needs to continue resting!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yuri’s making sure of that while we’re out here!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yoichi! That’s not a nice way to introduce someone!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe, I’m just glad it turned into such a great day for everyone.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I should check on her today to see if she’s feeling any better.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ahh… Sure thing, Aiden! Thanks a lot!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hello, you two! I brought your lunch, Emilia.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I hope I’m not interrupting anything.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whoa… I’m really surprised to hear that, Yuri.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I’m glad that you’re recovering just fine, Emilia!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wow, I never thought I’d hear that from you both!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Maybe you’ll end up as close friends after all, haha!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe… Maybe I spoke too soon.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, the scouts came by to help us shovel! I called Yoichi and Taiga last night, and the whole gang came along!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Wait, Yuri—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hehe, I’m really glad you two are getting along a little better now, Emilia…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, he was informed you weren’t feeling well, but we left the rest out for now.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: After all, we still have a situation on the site to deal with.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: But you don’t have to do that right now. We have everything under control with the work so far.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I understand, Emilia.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm, it seems like there’s quite the commotion outside. I wonder if something happened.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh… So that’s what I’ve been hearing outside.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Emilia—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-We only learned recently, sir. During our stay at the hotel.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah…! Yes...!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I know that we all started off on the wrong foot with Emilia, but we moved past our differences.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We talked about it, and we all want her to continue working with us.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even though she may have forged her credentials, her work ethic and commitment to the project are very much real.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We believe it would be in the best interests of both Emilia and Camp Buddy to have her stay.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We’ve all gone through our own hardships, making mistakes along the way.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It’s about how you change from here on out.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: What I do know is all of us would be glad to work further with you, but now that choice is entirely up to you.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Were you all really eavesdropping?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wow! Everything’s cleared out? That’s amazing! I guess we’re officially back on track then!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I guess, we don’t really have a choice, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh yeah, let me introduce you! You’re going to love them!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: That’s the spirit, Emilia! You’re speaking like a true buddy now!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Right!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wow… Yuri really went all out again with this event, huh…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Y-Yuri! What are you wearing!?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I… Uhh… Yeah?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *gulp*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, it sounds like you guys have had your own struggles with the storm the last few days.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: H-How do you always manage to pull off things like this on such short notice, Yuri?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh yeah, where is everyone else? They all ran off suddenly and I haven’t seen them yet…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* I guess Yoichi was right about the costumes…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’m surprised that the other staff are okay with this.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Wait… Is it okay for you to wear something like this…? I mean, maybe if it’s just us, but Mr. Clermont is here too, right…?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: M-Mr. Clermont…?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: S-Sir, I can’t believe you’re really wearing that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I don’t know how you even find the time, Yuri…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, I think it’s sweet you made these for everyone, Yuri.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well, I haven’t seen Goro yet either!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* You really were overprepared for this, Yuri…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Alright, alright.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Goro? Are you in here?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Whoa! What are you wearing?!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe, I'd say she definitely succeeded...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Are you sure it’s alright to go out there with just that on…? I mean… Won’t you get cold?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I'm not sure it would close even with that... It looks tight on your arms already.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Gah… I can’t help it, I couldn’t keep my eyes off your…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Gah… I can’t help it, I couldn’t keep my eyes off your…{fast}

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *gulp*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Th-That package is wrapped really nicely…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *gulp*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I’d like a taste of that candy cane…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *gulp*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: D-Do those balls jingle?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *gulp*

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Th-That stocking is stuffed…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Goro…!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Have you been spending too much time around Aiden?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* This costume Yuri gave me is so tight-fitting… I can’t even button it all the way up…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ahehe…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* You already made that joke...

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Ah! W-We had trouble putting on our costumes!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Well…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Why don’t we get something to eat?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: G-Gah! You’d think after a couple months, I’d be used to you teasing me like this, sir…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: A-Anyway, let’s check out the food bar.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hmm, it looks your favorite meatballs ran out, sir.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh yeah. I don’t see Aiden around. Maybe he’s making another serving!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Sure thing!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there, Aiden! …And Hiro?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Wow, you two are really in sync with each other. It’s almost like you’ve been cooking together forever.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Oh, sure! I’d love to.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Th-This is amazing, Hiro!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Ahehe, I guess Hiro and Yoichi still argue as much as they did before…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: J-Just don’t teach him all your habits, alright?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: *sigh* Aiden…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: It looks like Yuri’s hosting a game with some of the scouts.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah! Maybe we can join in too!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Hey there! Looks like something’s interesting’s going on here.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Both of them sound… wrong.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, it’s really nice to see you get excited when it comes to anything art related.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Even though it’d take a lot of time and effort, I think you could do it!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, what’s stopping you from going back to it now?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Yeah, I can understand that…

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Well, I think this off-season is the perfect time to start!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: You have some time to train, and you’d be able to come up with some really fun activities for the scouts!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: We may be in the middle of our work, but Sir Goro and I have the management stuff covered!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Haha, you can count on me, Yuri~ Take the chance you have and do the things you always wanted to.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: W-Wait, Yuri…! What about the—

name: Yoshinori
dialog: …party.

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Let’s go have some drinks!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: I see Lloyd and Darius with Mr. Clermont doing just that over there! Let’s join them!

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Good evening! Mind if we join in?

name: Yoshinori
dialog: Whoa! Really?!

name: Yoshinori

dialog: *sigh* I know I mentioned this before, but… I’m a bit disappointed we’re headed home today.

name: Goro
dialog: It’s been so nice to spend time with you privately, and now we’re headed back to share a room with everyone again.

name: Goro
dialog: And that’s not even including how busy we’ll be.

name: Goro
dialog: Heh, you seem pretty confident about that.

name: Goro
dialog: You say that, but you had no problem wrapping your head around my cock over the past few days.

name: Goro
dialog: Coming. Just a sec!

name: Goro
dialog: Here, Yoshinori. Get dressed.

name: Goro
dialog: Good morning, Yuri.

name: Goro
dialog: Come in, take a seat.

name: Goro
dialog: What brings you here, dear?

name: Goro
dialog: I’m fine, dear. Thanks for checking up on me.

name: Goro
dialog: Well, thankfully, Yoshinori was able to calm me down.

name: Goro
dialog: About that… I’m really sorry for walking out on you all so abruptly…

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, right… I did leave quite a mess back at the dinner… I’ll have to talk to the manager and formally apologize.

name: Goro
dialog: Thank you for taking care of that, Yuri… I was really worried it put us in serious trouble.

name: Goro
dialog: Anyway, I think it’s almost check-out time. Have you packed yet, dear?

name: Goro
dialog: It’s alright, I’m glad you did. You can go finish up, but make sure and dress warmly.

name: Goro
dialog: It looks quite cold out there…

name: Goro
dialog: Thanks, dear. Let’s just meet downstairs at the lobby.

name: Goro
dialog: Look at the entrance, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: Me either… The sky was even clear this morning from the view in our room.

name: Goro
dialog: Don’t stress yourself out, dear. It’s out of anyone’s control.

name: Goro
dialog: Jin’s right. We can’t let her disrespect the staff anymore than she has already.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll handle it.

name: Goro
dialog: No, Yoshinori, I’ll do it.

name: Goro
dialog: Mr. Clermont put my name as the head of our party, so it’s best if I resolve the situation myself.

name: Goro
dialog: You’re both right.  I’ll go and see what’s going on.

name: Goro
dialog: Let me handle this.

name: Goro
dialog: We need to know the situation, after all.

name: Goro
dialog: It’ll be fine, Yuri. Trust me, I know what to do this time.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* Ms. Komarova?

name: Goro
dialog: Let me take it from here.

name: Goro
dialog: Good morning. Firstly, I’d like to apologize on the behalf of Mr. Clermont’s party.

name: Goro
dialog: I understand we’re in a bit of a situation here?

name: Goro
dialog: Understood. Thank you for the update. That means we’ll have to extend our stay here, doesn’t it?

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, thank you very much. That should be everything we need.

name: Goro
dialog: Can you kindly escort her to her room, please?

name: Goro
dialog: I was expecting she’d throw a fit at me for interrupting, considering our debacle last night.

name: Goro
dialog: But I guess she thought I was on her side, and that was enough to shut her down.

name: Goro
dialog: Hehe… I was thinking the same thing, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: Although, as much as I’d like to stay here longer, hearing what Emilia said about our project has me concerned as well.

name: Goro
dialog: That’s right. I guess let’s make the most out of it while we’re still here.

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, yes, dear!

name: Goro
dialog: I’m fine now, everyone… I didn’t mean to make you all worry…

name: Goro
dialog: If I had controlled myself better, then none of that would’ve happened.

name: Goro
dialog: So, I really apologize for my behavior, and I promise I’ll try my best not to let that happen again.

name: Goro
dialog: Honestly, my personal history isn’t something I like to talk about… It’s a really sensitive topic for me.

name: Goro
dialog: You’re right, but it’s even worse that I did the same… I truly regret it…

name: Goro
dialog: Some of you aren’t familiar with the anger issues I had in the past..

name: Goro
dialog: I had hoped to put all of those toxic traits behind me after the last summer.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll do my best to not let them resurface again, and I sincerely hope my actions don’t change the way you see me, as both your leader and your friend.

name: Goro
dialog: Despite how I acted… Thank you all for keeping an open mind…

name: Goro
dialog: Well, I have Yoshinori to thank for that. He helped to calm me down and brought me back to my senses.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* Actually, since we’re on this topic… I think we should figure out how to address Emilia from hereon.

name: Goro
dialog: I honestly agree… I think this is the perfect opportunity for us all to come to an agreement and about how to move forward with building this team…

name: Goro
dialog: Hmmm… right now, while I do feel like that’s the correct choice, I fear that’s a big decision to jump straight to.

name: Goro
dialog: After all, last night is still fresh on our minds, and we should make that choice with clearer heads.

name: Goro
dialog: Yoshinori…

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… What are you all trying to say?

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… Her being so persistent to stay at camp does contradict her other views…

name: Goro
dialog: I agree… It is odd that someone with her work ethic and skill level qualified to be our sponsor’s representative.

name: Goro
dialog: All I know is that Mr. Clermont chose her mostly because she’s a former alumnus of the camp, on top of her credentials.

name: Goro
dialog: Well, we don’t have any of her information in our records other than her scout application.

name: Goro
dialog: And we just assumed that she was credible since she was put here by Mr. Clermont.

name: Goro
dialog: What we do know is that she does legitimately come from an elite background…

name: Goro
dialog: What about her parents? As I mentioned, we do have Ms. Komarova’s past scout registration.

name: Goro
dialog: There’s no way that Emilia could have maintained her lifestyle without her family’s wealth…

name: Goro
dialog: This is an extremely serious accusation…  Mr. Clermont would not take this lightly, I’m sure…

name: Goro
dialog: Calm down, dear. We can’t do anything rash.

name: Goro
dialog: I understand that what we just uncovered solidifies her removal from the project, but… you’ve seen how things turn out if we let ourselves get carried away.

name: Goro
dialog: There’s a right way to handle this. And the fact that she’s a camp alumnus could put the sponsorship at risk too…

name: Goro
dialog: Yes… Yoshinori knows what he’s doing…

name: Goro
dialog: Ah…! Yoshinori, you’re back.

name: Goro
dialog: How did it go?

name: Goro
dialog: Looks like Emilia didn’t take it well, huh?

name: Goro
dialog: Just as I expected…

name: Goro
dialog: I see…

name: Goro
dialog: Everyone else was a bit worried how she’d react towards you.

name: Goro
dialog: From how things escalated yesterday between her and I, I can only imagine how she’d lash out after being confronted with something so serious.

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… I can’t tell either… But what I do know is you tried your best.

name: Goro
dialog: As complicated as it is, perhaps it needed to happen for us to understand her actions.

name: Goro
dialog: I mean… It doesn’t make sense that she would go out of her way to put herself in such trouble without a motive.

name: Goro
dialog: But that’s not your fault, Yoshinori. People naturally drift apart, even from those closest to them.

name: Goro
dialog: Just look at my marriage, or even how we were separated. It takes maturity to realize that such things happen.

name: Goro
dialog: You’re very kind, Yoshinori… Possibly too kind.

name: Goro
dialog: You really amaze me with how understanding you can be with people.

name: Goro
dialog: That’s a gift you’ve always had, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: But you’ve done what you can for her now. It’s her turn to realize that talking to her means that you care.

name: Goro
dialog: Just give it some time, maybe then she’ll be ready to talk.

name: Goro
dialog: Now, let’s get some rest. It’s been a long day today.

name: Goro
dialog: Good night, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: Yeah, some groups are already checking out.

name: Goro
dialog: The last two nights were pretty rough. Hopefully they didn’t spoil the whole getaway for you.

name: Goro
dialog: I did notice you tossing and turning last night… but try not to worry so much, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: We can resolve everything once we get back to the camp.

name: Goro
dialog: After everything that’s happened at the hotel, I think it’s best if we try and handle it away from here… but I do expect it to be an awkward bus ride back.

name: Goro
dialog: Just bear with it a little longer, alright?

name: Goro
dialog: I sent everyone a message to make sure they are prepared to go, including Emilia…

name: Goro
dialog: Wait, Yoshinori... You told me last night Emilia wanted to quit… Do you think she was serious about that…?

name: Goro
dialog: Regardless, if she really is planning on quitting, that must be settled back at camp.

name: Goro
dialog: Calm down, Yuri. Let the doctor explain everything.

name: Goro
dialog: You can leave it to me. I’ll keep an eye on her.

name: Goro
dialog: Thanks for the help, doctor.

name: Goro
dialog: We’re proceeding as planned. The doctor said it’s safe for Emilia to travel.

name: Goro
dialog: I was planning on doing that when we got home… I really don’t want him to extend our stay here any longer, especially after what just happened.

name: Goro
dialog: But once he finds out about Emilia’s lies… I’m sure he won’t hesitate to fire her…

name: Goro
dialog: It was out of our control. None of us could’ve predicted this would happen.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m sure we all played a role in this, but it won’t help Emilia, or any of us for that matter, if we keep focusing on what went wrong.

name: Goro
dialog: For now, let’s head back to camp. We’ll figure out what to do next when we’re all settled in.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll carry Emilia to the shuttle and get her situated.

name: Goro
dialog: Lloyd, Darius, gather the workers and have them board the shuttle as well.

name: Goro
dialog: Yoshinori and the rest, kindly pack Emilia’s belongings and make sure we don’t leave anything behind.

name: Goro
dialog: It looks like the snowstorm hit harder here than expected while we were away…

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll take her from here, dear.

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, Emilia… You’re awake.

name: Goro
dialog: We’re back at Camp Buddy. You were passed out for the whole day.

name: Goro
dialog: How are you feeling…?

name: Goro
dialog: No, I’m only watching over you. Yuri’s been the one nursing you all day…  She just went out to fetch your medicine.

name: Goro
dialog: You gave us quite the scare back there… It’s a good thing Yoshinori found you just in time.

name: Goro
dialog: You would’ve been in a worse state if it were a little later.

name: Goro
dialog: Well, what matters is that you’re home now. Everyone was quite worried about you.

name: Goro
dialog: Take it easy, Emilia… You’re not well.

name: Goro
dialog: You need to stay put and recover.

name: Goro
dialog: I know we have our differences… But, I won’t let a disagreement get in the way of your well-being.

name: Goro
dialog: What I said to you and how I acted… I want you to know that I regret them.

name: Goro
dialog: You don’t need to accept it but… I apologize for everything.

name: Goro
dialog: Because no matter how you look at it, I did something wrong. And neither of us can move forward if we don’t come to an understanding.

name: Goro
dialog: And, after thinking about it, I know why you ended up saying everything you did…

name: Goro
dialog: I believe you and I share a common trait when it comes to managing our emotions.

name: Goro
dialog: When we keep things to ourselves, it just boils up inside until it explodes…

name: Goro
dialog: And in those moments, we end up losing sight of what’s right…

name: Goro
dialog: I just want you to know that I don’t have anything personal against you. We all have our own struggles, and I apologize for not attempting to learn yours.

name: Goro
dialog: Where will you go…?

name: Goro
dialog: No, it’s not. You still have Camp Buddy.

name: Goro
dialog: I might not know the full story… But you’ve gone through so much and now’s not the time to give up.

name: Goro
dialog: Look… I know how important it is to you to be independent and tough… As a leader, I bear that responsibility as well.

name: Goro
dialog: But sometimes, it’s alright to show vulnerability… It helps others to understand you better and find ways to help you.

name: Goro
dialog: Whatever happened to you before caused you plenty of pain, frustration and anger, and you’ve been battling it alone… so it’s no wonder things turned out this way…

name: Goro
dialog: Back when my wife and I separated… I thought I could handle it all myself, but I couldn’t.

name: Goro
dialog: I started taking what I had left for granted, not realizing how much people around me cared.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m sure if you stop and look around as well, you can find something worth fighting for too.

name: Goro
dialog: A-Ah, I apologize… I didn’t mean to get carried away. I only wanted to let you know that I can sympathize with where you are right now.

name: Goro
dialog: In any case, I’m sure you need to rest… So please, take it easy and we can talk when—

name: Goro
dialog: Hey, Yuri… Don’t work her up too much, she’s still recovering…

name: Goro
dialog: I’m really humbled by your acknowledgement, Emilia… But please, save your tears…

name: Goro
dialog: You were once a part of Camp Buddy… So, don’t let anything change that.

name: Goro
dialog: You can’t give up now, Emilia… It’s not too late to make things right.

name: Goro
dialog: There’s obviously change that needs to happen, and we can only do so much to help you.

name: Goro
dialog: It has to come from you… I’m sure you’re tired of living in your old ways too.

name: Goro
dialog: You can do something about it, especially now that you have people to support you.

name: Goro
dialog: I know you’re a fighter, Emilia. We both are… And fighters don’t go down easily, no matter what!

name: Goro
dialog: Just keep moving forward and never give up!

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem*

name: Goro
dialog: Alright then. I’ll see you two tomorrow.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* I blame you for rubbing off on me.

name: Goro
dialog: Uhh… Jin? You should really go back to the cabin. You may catch a cold at this rate.

name: Goro
dialog: This seems to be a bigger problem than I anticipated… I think we should stop for now.  It will only get colder since the sun has just set too.

name: Goro
dialog: Let’s continue tomorrow. Hopefully we can make more progress.

name: Goro
dialog: Sadly, the workers won’t arrive till next week… I don’t think we have much of a choice but to do it ourselves.

name: Goro
dialog: I don’t think that’s a very productive motto, Aiden…

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… Can I request some sausage and eggs…? I’m really craving them for some reason.

name: Goro
dialog: You’re already drooling. I’ll share my sausage and give you a mouthful.

name: Goro
dialog: Over here, Yoshinori. I saved you a plate.

name: Goro
dialog: She finally realized she had made her fair share of mistakes, in fact. I am glad she’s beginning to take accountability for her actions.

name: Goro
dialog: Either way, I’m just glad we can try and move past it. It’s possible we could get along with Emilia now after all.

name: Goro
dialog: No. Mr. Clermont is our sponsor, and he deserves to know the truth at some point.

name: Goro
dialog: If he found out later that we’d been hiding such a thing from him, I’m sure it would be much worse.

name: Goro
dialog: But l believe we can all agree that can wait for a while, to buy some time and allow Emilia to recover.

name: Goro
dialog: What do you mean, Yoshinori?

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… Clearly, our camp is understaffed. And every little bit of help counts at this point.

name: Goro
dialog: So it seems we’re all willing to give Emilia another chance.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll make sure to consider what everyone has said.

name: Goro
dialog: Regardless, I’ll have to report to Mr. Clermont on both the camp’s situation and Emilia being sick.

name: Goro
dialog: Either way, I’m impressed, Yoshinori. Every day you’re becoming more of a leader.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ve said it before, but you’ll do a fine job leading this place one day.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* I-I just thought it was appropriate to give proper praise.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* Actually, Yoshinori and Jin here are trying to log down all the memories in Yuri’s journal, from the camp’s first term and up until now.

name: Goro
dialog: Yoshinori!

name: Goro
dialog: W-Were you just in my office…?

name: Goro
dialog: Are you sure…? I swear I heard-

name: Goro
dialog: What’s that on your…?

name: Goro
dialog: Wait, Yoshinori…!

name: Goro
dialog: Hmmm… Maybe I’m just imagining things, but…

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* Don’t get carried away, Jin.

name: Goro
dialog: *yawn* Good morning. You’re all up earlier than usual.

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, thanks Aiden.

name: Goro
dialog: What are you guys up to?

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm, you have quite a lot of interesting hobbies, Lloyd.

name: Goro
dialog: You’ve piqued my interest either way… how does it work…?

name: Goro
dialog: What does mine say?

name: Goro
dialog: And that means…?

name: Goro
dialog: Speaking of breaking ice, did Yoshinori already go to the site to work? I don’t see him.

name: Goro
dialog: I can’t work well without it, so I thought it’d give you a boost too.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* I prefer it this way.

name: Goro
dialog: On that note, I guess we should get dressed and start our day as well.

name: Goro
dialog: Huh? Do we have visitors?

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, welcome scouts! I wasn’t expecting a visit from all of you.

name: Goro
dialog: So, what brings you boys back here?

name: Goro
dialog: It’ll get very cold in the evenings so everyone, including the pups, can stay in the cabins for the night.

name: Goro
dialog: I assume you’re the one who informed the scouts of our situation, Yoshinori?

name: Goro
dialog: Are you boys sure it’s alright to spend the day working here, though? You aren’t skipping your studies, are you?

name: Goro
dialog: It’s a bit of a shame you boys have to see the camp in this state.

name: Goro
dialog: Jin has quite a few more upgrades he’s working on as well, but I was relieved to see that none of them would disrupt the spirit of the camp.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* Anyway, thank you all for volunteering to help. We were a bit worried about the lack of manpower yesterday.

name: Goro
dialog: You’ve all already done so much for the camp during your term that it feels a bit embarrassing to ask for more, but I’m grateful nonetheless.

name: Goro
dialog: Let’s make sure you boys are all properly geared up before we get to work.

name: Goro
dialog: The snow boots should be in the shed. Come with me, scouts!

name: Goro
dialog: Now don’t discredit your work so far. All of your efforts count.

name: Goro
dialog: Hmm… Outside of the fundraising we did last term… I guess you’re right.

name: Goro
dialog: They’re telling the truth, Jin. Even the scoutmasters were intimidated by me for the last couple years…

name: Goro
dialog: Even still, it doesn’t excuse my unnecessarily steely demeanor.

name: Goro
dialog: As the figurehead, I should’ve served as a guiding example by handling everything with patience and compassion.

name: Goro
dialog: But I’m glad everyone, including the scouts, kept an open mind and were able to give me time to change my ways.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* Let’s not get too sentimental, we still have a lot of work to do.

name: Goro
dialog: Yeah, I agree… Could you imagine Camp Buddy as a gacha game?

name: Goro
dialog: Hey, watch it, boy.

name: Goro
dialog: Either way, working at a summer camp exclusively puts people like Yoshinori and I at a disadvantage.

name: Goro
dialog: Usually the local city hall sends their assistance, and I’ve been in touch with them since yesterday. Unfortunately, they’re still occupied clearing public roads.

name: Goro
dialog: For now, we’ll have to make do.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* Why am I in the spotlight again…?

name: Goro
dialog: I agree. Their presence here today really boosted our morale.

name: Goro
dialog: I’m not going to lie, I was feeling rather stressed out after dealing with issues one after another since we left the hotel.

name: Goro
dialog: Thank you for taking the initiative and finding a solution to our issues, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: This actually leaves me a little bit of time to give an update to Mr. Clermont.

name: Goro
dialog: He should be a bit relieved to hear that we got additional help today.

name: Goro
dialog: See you later then, Yoshinori.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* The roadway is still covered in snow…

name: Goro
dialog: At this rate, I don’t think the city would be able to help us anytime soon.

name: Goro
dialog: Huh…? Who’s—

name: Goro
dialog: Mr. Clermont?!

name: Goro
dialog: Wh-What do you mean, sir?

name: Goro
dialog: Once again, this is too much, sir… You’ve already given so much to the camp, and now you’re taking time to personally visit.

name: Goro
dialog: That’s not necessary, sir! I do think with the combination of the machines that you brought and the extra help from the scouts, we may be able to finish everything today!

name: Goro
dialog: W-Wait, Mr. Clermont, please let me carry that!

name: Goro
dialog: The way they’re using the snowblowers makes it look like it’s not even a chore anymore.

name: Goro
dialog: I don’t know how to thank you, Mr. Clermont. You’ve done so much for us over these past few months.

name: Goro
dialog: First it was the sponsorship, then our vacation, and now you’re taking time out of your busy life to help us with even minor inconveniences.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* I’m just being grateful!

name: Goro
dialog: Ah…

name: Goro
dialog: Alright, please follow me.

name: Goro
dialog: Mr. Clermont came here after my report this morning… He brought in some equipment to help clear the grounds.

name: Goro
dialog: Our intent was to let Emilia recover, then inform you.

name: Goro
dialog: We weren’t aware of this matter either until recently like I said. You can at least be relieved to know that we managed to fix it amongst ourselves.

name: Goro
dialog: But Mr. Clermont, if I may?

name: Goro
dialog: I understand your decision to remove Emilia as our inspector.

name: Goro
dialog: However, with your permission, I’d like to offer her a position here at Camp Buddy.

name: Goro
dialog: I’ve been speaking with the rest of the staff and gathering their thoughts on the matter.

name: Goro
dialog: Yoshinori, if you wouldn’t mind explaining?

name: Goro
dialog: It’s alright, everyone, we’re about finished. What brings you all here anyway?

name: Goro
dialog: Good job, everyone!

name: Goro
dialog: Yuri… We literally just came back from a vacation… Is this really necessary…?

name: Goro
dialog: I’ll go get us some liquor!

name: Goro
dialog: Ah, Yoshinori. Yes, I’m here.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* I'm not sure either, but Yuri was insistent that I wear it.

name: Goro
dialog: She says that she regretted how 'covered' I was during the last costume party and wanted to give me more eye-candy this time.

name: Goro
dialog: I actually tried to close the jacket, but there's no buttons. I think she did that on purpose.

name: Goro
dialog: Heh, I’m surprised you noticed my arms from where you’ve been staring.

name: Goro
dialog: Really? Why don’t you come open it then~?

name: Goro
dialog: You can take a lick if you’d like~

name: Goro
dialog: Depends on how you play with them.

name: Goro
dialog: Why don’t you give it a try?

name: Goro
dialog: It’s about to be stuffed somewhere else~

name: Goro
dialog: What? You’re dressed like you’re ready to crack some nuts, anyways.

name: Goro
dialog: Hah! Hardly.

name: Goro
dialog: Besides, let’s be honest, with how the last few days have been, we could both use some heat.

name: Goro
dialog: So, come over here and warm up with me before the party…

name: Goro
dialog: The sides of my jacket don’t even connect. Closing it is impossible.

name: Goro
dialog: It’s also not much better than being naked in this weather… The cold outside felt miserable.

name: Goro
dialog: Good thing you warmed me up beforehand.

name: Goro
dialog: I have to say though, your costume suits you very well. You’re quite the expert at nut cracking, as I saw.

name: Goro
dialog: But I’m not joking.

name: Goro
dialog: I was popping something else.

name: Goro
dialog: Give us a break, Yuri. We spent the whole day outside digging.

name: Goro
dialog: Poor Yoshinori here was panting like a dog a few minutes ago.

name: Goro
dialog: So, what do you want to do for the night, Yoshinori?

name: Goro
dialog: So, what do you want to do for the night, Yoshinori?{fast}

name: Goro
dialog: Oh? You still have an appetite after your ‘meal’ earlier?

name: Goro
dialog: Hahaha! I understand why Aiden does it so often. You make it too easy.

name: Goro
dialog: Maybe there’s still some left in the kitchen.

name: Goro
dialog: Why don’t we go and see then?

name: Goro
dialog: Looks like you’ve put Hiro to work here, Aiden. Shouldn’t he be out partying with his friends?

name: Goro
dialog: Yes, it’s as good as Aiden’s.

name: Goro
dialog: Still, I’m impressed by his cooking. I don’t think we’ve had another scout since you that was that capable, Aiden.

name: Goro
dialog: Heh, maybe he’d like a job as your sous chef one day.

name: Goro
dialog: *ehem* Anyway, we just came to get some of those meatballs.

name: Goro
dialog: Want to check it out?

name: Goro
dialog: Hehe, Yoshinori… We're not that young anymore…

name: Goro
dialog: What game are you all playing…? Natsumi’s doing some really... provocative poses.

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* Yuri… Why are you making the scouts work during a party?

name: Goro
dialog: *sigh* You two are coming with me. We’re going to party.

name: Goro

dialog: I never experienced them growing up, and always was disgusted by ‘dirty work.’

name: Emilia
dialog: Now, I feel a real sense of fulfilment when I complete them, seeing everyone enjoy the comfort as a direct result of my hard work.

name: Emilia
dialog: Not to mention that I’m learning new skills as well.

name: Emilia
dialog: Ah, it’s so nice to see this new part of our camp in full bloom. I feel like a proud mother seeing all my plants grow so prettily~

name: Emilia
dialog: Come on you two! Learn to relax, we deserve it after all!
