name: Emilia
dialog: Like what? Arts and crafts?

name: Emilia
dialog: Honestly, I’m eager to meet the scouts. I’ll definitely give them a proper introduction.

name: Emilia
dialog: But they’d better not get on my bad side.

name: Emilia
dialog: Oh, speaking of which… looks like some people really can’t wait for summer.

name: Emilia
dialog: I guess… they’re getting the hang of it…

name: Emilia
dialog: Speaking of Yoshi… When are he and Aiden going to be back?

name: Emilia
dialog: How come those two are allowed to go on dates and we’re not?!

name: Emilia
dialog: What?! So, you’re telling me I could’ve been out on a vacation instead of digging up soil and weeding for weeks?!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s because I thought there was nothing else to do! I’ve been scammed!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hey, don’t change the subject! We need to go on a vacation too!

name: Emilia
dialog: If that’s the case then pack your bags, Yuri! We’re going to see that new ‘JS’ movie!

name: Emilia
dialog: Speaking of Yoshi… Where is he?! I haven’t seen him today.

name: Emilia
dialog: Yeah… I’d kill to be in a nice, air-conditioned establishment too…

name: Emilia
dialog: Sure, I think I’ve finished all the chores for the day. Turns out they aren’t so bad when nobody is around.

name: Emilia
dialog: W-Wait, Sir Goro didn’t even say yes yet…!

name: Emilia
dialog: Calm down, Yuri… It’s not like they’re dying.

name: Emilia
dialog: Well, I have nowhere else to be anyway… and I’ll probably be taking over Aiden’s job.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’ve grown quite fond of this place, after all.  And I’m even adjusting to a simpler life!

name: Emilia
dialog: So, call me Chef Emilia from now on~!

name: Emilia
dialog: HEY! That was just an experiment!

name: Emilia
dialog: Y-Yuri?! You’re not gonna catch that bus on foot! Are you stupid?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Thank you for bringing this up, Mr. Clermont. I believe these matters are of utmost importance.

name: Emilia
dialog: As the standing representative for quality assurance, I wanted to discuss some specific departmental concerns that need to be corrected.

name: Emilia
dialog: Let’s start off with Mr. Choi. I’ve found his reversed sleep schedule to be very unprofessional.

name: Emilia
dialog: He sleeps the whole day starting from 9:00 am until 6:00 pm which are the peak productivity hours. There was no way for me to reach him in-person to oversee his work.

name: Emilia
dialog: Even so, it would’ve been optimal if he were accessible in the same time frame as everyone else. Not to mention that it’s a potential health concern.

name: Emilia
dialog: Moving on to the construction department, I have noticed inconsistencies with the time cards of Mr. Sirius and Mr. Najjar.

name: Emilia
dialog: From my observations, it was mostly due to the unnecessarily extensive morning routines they partake in.

name: Emilia
dialog: Which brings me to another issue: Ms. Nomoru’s attitude problem. She’s very hostile towards me, as you can see.

name: Emilia
dialog: And last but not least, I have a strange issue with Mr. Flynn. According to my investigations, he was still exhibiting indecent behavior around camp.

name: Emilia
dialog: Even though I pointed it out at the beginning, it seems that he refused to listen to initial warnings and there were still instances of such displays.

name: Emilia
dialog: With the weather getting colder, surely a habit like that is unnecessary. I just thought it was important to point out.

name: Emilia
dialog: Although, I have to give props where they’re due. If it weren’t for Mr. Nagira being in charge of overseeing Mr. Flynn’s department, things could’ve been worse.

name: Emilia
dialog: Not to mention, if one of the staff is handling JUST the maintenance, wouldn’t it make more sense that the scoutmaster title for Mr. Flynn be revoked and changed back to a ‘helper’?

name: Emilia
dialog: Not to mention, if one of the staff is handling JUST the maintenance, wouldn’t it make more sense that the scoutmaster title for Mr. Flynn be revoked and changed back to a ‘helper’?{fast}

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m only telling things as they are. I can’t let an opportunity to point out legitimate flaws pass.

name: Emilia
dialog: O-Of course I can! My only intent was—

name: Emilia
dialog: Mr. Clermont, please allow me to explain—

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph!

name: Emilia
dialog: What?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Seriously?! After everyone tore into me back there, you still have the nerve to attack me like this?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Understand me?! I tried to get back in touch with you from the start, and you never once reciprocated!

name: Emilia
dialog: Here I was trying my hardest to help you and this stupid camp, but you didn’t think twice about humiliating me in front of everyone!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m just doing my job! It’s not my fault that none of you can accept how wrong you all are!

name: Emilia
dialog: Aiden again?! All you ever talk about is him!

name: Emilia
dialog: You know what, I’m done with you, Yoshinori.

name: Emilia
dialog: And I thought you were my friend...

name: Emilia
dialog: You’ve changed.

name: Emilia
dialog: Don’t talk to me.

name: Emilia
dialog: *facepalms* Eugh…

name: Emilia
dialog: Hnghhh…!! Why in the world is no one helping me with my luggage?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Don’t bother. There are people here paid to be doing this.

name: Emilia
dialog: What kind of service does this place have!? A bellboy should have helped me with my bags the moment we got off that shuttle!

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t believe no one welcomed me either, do they even know who sent us here?! Where’s my room?! I thought this was a five-star luxury hotel?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I want to speak with the manager!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ugh! It’s about time!

name: Emilia
dialog: Finally. Something closer to home.

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph, bold of you people to assume I want to share a room with the likes of you!

name: Emilia
dialog: *snatches keys*

name: Emilia
dialog: Just like at the camp, I require my own room, thank you very much.

name: Emilia
dialog: I hate to stay and listen to your pointless bickering, so I’d best be on my way.

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp*

name: Emilia
dialog: Goodness fucking gracious! How dare you sneak up on me like that!

name: Emilia
dialog: What the hell do you want?

name: Emilia
dialog: Now all of a sudden you’re interested? It’s none of your business. Leave me alone.

name: Emilia
dialog: For your information, I was having a good time before you came along.

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t need other people to enjoy a vacation! Especially now that I’m finally in a place up to my standards.

name: Emilia
dialog: Would you stop that already?!

name: Emilia
dialog: You know what you’re doing! You’re acting like that goody-two-shoes scout that pretends to care about everything!

name: Emilia
dialog: I know better now than to get tricked by fake people like you!

name: Emilia
dialog: If you came here to ruin my oh-so-perfect-day. Congratulations, you just did.

name: Emilia
dialog: I heard screaming did someone— oh…

name: Emilia
dialog: Ew.

name: Emilia
dialog: How scandalous… I’m not taking any part in this.

name: Emilia
dialog: Gadgets aren’t allowed at camp! How come that rule doesn’t apply to you?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Oh, I KNOW! It’s because you’re the owner’s daughter! Talk about rampant nepotism! This camp is absolutely ridiculous!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s not just about this stupid camera! You get away with EVERYTHING!

name: Emilia
dialog: You get to skip activities whenever you want, bring your books on camping trips, and they even let you stay with everyone in the boys’ cabins!!

name: Emilia
dialog: If you can get your demands fulfilled on a whim, then why can’t I as well?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t want this ugly uniform, I want my own designer wardrobe!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m sick and tired of being fed commoner’s grub every meal! I want my personal chef!

name: Emilia
dialog: And last but not the least, I don’t want to share a room with girls who keep gossiping about me just because they’re jealous!

name: Emilia
dialog: Is that too much to ask?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Not until you tell your dad to give me everything I just said!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s not my fault that you look like one!

name: Emilia
dialog: Sh-Shut up! My parents love me! They buy me EVERYTHING I ask for!

name: Emilia
dialog: I—

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m a WHAT?! Take that back!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: EURGH! How dare you?!

name: Emilia
dialog: *throws Yuri’s camera on the ground*

name: Emilia
dialog: *tramples the camera*

name: Emilia
dialog: Nobody calls me a bitch!!! Take that!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Just ask daddy for a new one~! Oh wait, you’re too poor to afford another!

name: Emilia
dialog: Owww!! You’re ruining my hair!!! I spent all morning styling this!!

name: Emilia
dialog: I told you, stop calling me a bitch!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: *sobs* Look what she did to my hair! Thanks for saving me from this bully, Yoshi!

name: Emilia
dialog: She… just… attacked me out of nowhere!

name: Emilia
dialog: She’s the one who pulled my hair first! I was just defending myself!

name: Emilia
dialog: She should be punished for this! You can’t let this slide just because she’s your daughter!!

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t believe you served me something raw! Touch this meat and tell me that’s not just taken straight out of the fridge!

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I knew that! But I’m not trying to get salmonella on my vacation, is that too hard to understand?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I didn’t come here to eat something that common! Now, cook this meat up before I sue this entire place!

name: Emilia
dialog: *sigh* Can’t even have a good time around here…

name: Emilia
dialog: Are you just going to stand over there and pretend I didn’t see you?

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph! If you assumed I needed you or anyone’s help then you’re sorely mistaken.

name: Emilia
dialog: You have the nerve to tell me that? Don’t tell me how I should spend my time!

name: Emilia
dialog: None of you invited me anyway, so why should I bother squeezing myself into a group who doesn’t give a damn in the first place?

name: Emilia
dialog: I’d rather be alone than spend my precious time pretending to be friends with people like you.

name: Emilia
dialog: What?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Who are we kidding here, Yoshinori? I hate all of you, and you all hate me. There’s no secret there.

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s nowhere close to what I’m used to.

name: Emilia
dialog: You know I have high standards, considering I get way better food, service and atmosphere at home than at this mediocre hotel!

name: Emilia
dialog: But don’t get me wrong, this is far more bearable than having to stay in that raggedy camp.

name: Emilia
dialog: GRAH! Why are you suddenly probing me about all of this?! As if I needed one more person to keep scrutinizing everything I do!

name: Emilia
dialog: This is exactly why I wanted to be alone in the first place!

name: Emilia
dialog: Everything here is primitive and disgusting! And the commoners here make me sick!

name: Emilia
dialog: Surely there was a better option than this trashy camp! At the very least you could’ve let me stay at home alone!

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t stand being here for another minute! Why did you even send me here?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I know that you’re out of the country! Shouldn’t I have gone with you?!

name: Emilia
dialog: You’re always leaving me behind! And all you and Dad ever do is scold me when you’re around!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s like you don’t even care about me! You’re the worst—

name: Emilia
dialog: Did you really send me here just to punish me?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I don’t need strangers giving me useless life lessons!

name: Emilia
dialog: Wh-What…?! N-No! You can’t do that!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Mom, please!! Don’t leave me here!

name: Emilia
dialog: I—

name: Emilia
dialog: GRAHHH!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: *throws phone on the ground*

name: Emilia
dialog: Stupid camp! Stupid parents! Stupid everything!!

name: Emilia
dialog: How long have you been standing there?! Were you spying on me?!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s none of your business! And don’t you dare tell anyone what you’ve heard!

name: Emilia
dialog: You’re just gonna use that to get me in trouble, aren’t you?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Shut up! Just leave me alone like everyone else!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: MAKE WAY! MAKE WAY! The queen of the night has arrived!

name: Emilia
dialog: Well?! Not even one compliment? I didn’t put on a lovely dress just to be ignored!

name: Emilia
dialog: *chuckles* I know~

name: Emilia
dialog: I was pleasantly surprised to find out Mr. Clermont arranged a fine dining experience for us tonight! Truly such a treat~!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s been a hot minute since my last one! But better late than never!

name: Emilia
dialog: You have a good eye for luxury, Mr. Nomoru~ Of course I’ve brought my own attire!

name: Emilia
dialog: Dress to impress, after all! I wouldn’t be caught dead wearing a free tacky dress, unlike someone~

name: Emilia
dialog: No, thank you! Like they say, beauty is pain~

name: Emilia
dialog: The gown? Cucci! The feathers? Verse-ace! The shoes? Louis Butt-on! The jewelry? Stiffany & Ho!

name: Emilia
dialog: All custom made for me!

name: Emilia
dialog: Teehee~ It’s no surprise anyone would be jealous. I mean… who wouldn’t be over someone like me?

name: Emilia
dialog: Now! Where are we supposed to sit? Shouldn’t we be getting served right about now?

name: Emilia
dialog: WAITER!

name: Emilia
dialog: You! Aren’t you gonna show us our table?! Don’t you know that we’re VIP guests here?!

name: Emilia
dialog: That should’ve been obvious upon my arrival! Now, show me to the best seat in here!

name: Emilia
dialog: Why, there’s no need for that~ I’ve had plenty of experience with fine dining establishments, and I know exactly what I want!

name: Emilia
dialog: For an appetizer, I’ll have the smoked salmon crostini with herbed mayo— Actually, hold the mayo, and use pesto instead~

name: Emilia
dialog: For the main course, give me the petit beef wellington, obviously it had better be made with filet mignon and hand-kneaded puff pastry.

name: Emilia
dialog: Medium RARE, oh, and don’t overdo it. Trust me, I’ll know.

name: Emilia
dialog: Lastly, for dessert… I’ll keep it simple. I’ll have a vanilla crème brulee topped with fresh blueberries and a dash of raspberry coulis.

name: Emilia
dialog: First timers, am I right?

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s bouillabaisse my dear, it’s a good thing I’m here. If anyone needs help with the menu, I don’t mind educating you~

name: Emilia
dialog: Pardon my intrusion, but I can’t help but overhear your selections… Wouldn’t it be such a wasted opportunity to order something so basic?

name: Emilia
dialog: For someone labeled as a chef, you seem to have a simple palette.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m sure chances to experience high-class meals are once in a blue moon for you, so why not try something new for once to elevate yours and everyone’s taste level?

name: Emilia
dialog: Luckily, I’m in such a good mood today, so I don’t mind offering some suggestions~

name: Emilia
dialog: For the main, the superior choice is obviously the slow roasted pork belly~ Flavorful and hearty.

name: Emilia
dialog: Mr. Sirius, if you prefer seafood with a higher price point, then the choice for you is lobster bisque! Black truffle dal for Mr. Najjar. And saffron chicken paella for everyone else~

name: Emilia
dialog: As for the appetizers—

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph. Suit yourselves, then!

name: Emilia
dialog: I beg to differ. A restaurant this high-caliber would definitely deliver more sophistication than just plain pork and beans.

name: Emilia
dialog: Why— There’s no way I’d behave with such disgusting table manners, even more so over commoner’s grub!

name: Emilia
dialog: Of course, I have to make sure and be the first one up as the inspector! Don’t twist my actions into something else to fit your narrative.

name: Emilia
dialog: A-About time…!

name: Emilia
dialog: Simpletons! These are just the appetizers! They’re supposed to be small!

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s the point! It’s meant to stimulate your senses, to build up your appetite for the main course!

name: Emilia
dialog: Did you really think they’d serve pizza in a place like this? You really are out of touch!

name: Emilia
dialog: And you’re not supposed to shove it down your throat and swallow it like a pill! You’re ruining the experience!

name: Emilia
dialog: Look at how it’s done! I sliced mine into four equal parts, making sure each part has every ingredient, allowing me to savor each bite!

name: Emilia
dialog: If only everyone had listened to my recommendations, then you wouldn’t have missed out~

name: Emilia
dialog: Not with those horrible table manners, he can’t.

name: Emilia
dialog: I mean… He’s using his dessert spoon for the main course, his elbows are on the table, and I can hear his chewing from over here!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s unrealistic to expect a homecook to replicate a dish like this if he’s not even aware of basic dining etiquette.

name: Emilia
dialog: Professionals have spent years in culinary school studying and mastering the craft.

name: Emilia
dialog: See? He said it himself.

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s honestly quite a stretch to claim that bloodline has anything to do with technical skills like culinary arts.

name: Emilia
dialog: No, no. Let’s talk about it, since she’s questioning my abilities.

name: Emilia
dialog: I think I’ve proven how skilled I am over the last few months with actual results.

name: Emilia
dialog: Without me, your whole project wouldn’t have gotten this far, and we wouldn’t be sitting here enjoying this lovely dinner.

name: Emilia
dialog: I cannot believe what I’m hearing! You’re all just trying to discredit me, just like you did in that meeting!

name: Emilia
dialog: If anything, all of you just can’t accept honest criticism!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s awfully convenient for all of you to point at me for your own shortcomings, isn’t it?

name: Emilia
dialog: What about Mr. Scoutmaster Chef here who lacks any sort of professionalism?!

name: Emilia
dialog: You all let him get away with basically anything as if he wasn’t carrying the camp’s reputation with him!

name: Emilia
dialog: Why, even here at an all-expense paid luxury resort, he lacks the dignity to not cause a commotion!

name: Emilia
dialog: He humiliated your beloved camp, putting the sponsorship at risk, by getting drunk and once again flaunting his obscenity in a public place!

name: Emilia
dialog: Not only that, but he has zero credentials and no formal training whatsoever to be in a position of leadership!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s really absurd that you all continue to humor this beggar and claim that he’s of such great value!

name: Emilia
dialog: You won’t even consider the facts I’m stating! You’re just proving my point about how you ALWAYS cover for him!

name: Emilia
dialog: If you want to keep feeding him false hope, then by all means! Let him live with all your pathetic lies!

name: Emilia
dialog: No wonder he sticks around you so much, all you ever do is make him believe he belongs somewhere he never deserved to be!

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp*

name: Emilia
dialog: As well you should! I can’t believe you—

name: Emilia
dialog: Oh dear, and it’s all over that fine suit of yours – no, wait, that belongs to Mr. Clermont, doesn’t it?

name: Emilia
dialog: *sips* Well, that’s something you don’t see every day~

name: Emilia
dialog: Well, maybe all of you shouldn’t have been so rude, then none of this would’ve happened.

name: Emilia
dialog: W-Why, I can’t believe you’re letting her humiliate me like this ag—

name: Emilia
dialog: So, you’re saying we're stuck here?! This is unacceptable!

name: Emilia
dialog: I want to speak to the manager!

name: Emilia
dialog: Don’t you know how much is at stake by keeping us locked up in here?! We’re already behind schedule with our project!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ugh! I wouldn’t be surprised if this was just a ploy to force us into paying for another night!

name: Emilia
dialog: Where do you think we’ll get the money to pay for something outrageous like this?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Y-You should’ve said that sooner, then!

name: Emilia
dialog: And what about my bags?! You’re not expecting me to carry them back all the way to the top floor again, are you?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph!

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp*

name: Emilia
dialog: I didn’t order any room service! Leave me alone!

name: Emilia
dialog: Y-Yoshi? What are you doing here? What do you want?

name: Emilia
dialog: Well, let’s talk somewhere else. Give me just a bit to get ready.

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Huh…? What is this about?

name: Emilia
dialog: Look, I’m not in the mood for more preaching if that’s what you’re here for.

name: Emilia
dialog: So, leave me alone and get lo—

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp*

name: Emilia
dialog: W-What the hell do you want from me…?!

name: Emilia
dialog: What…?

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t know what you’re talking about! Wh-Who told you all of this?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Of course not! I can’t believe that you’re accusing me of such things! Whoever told that to you is probably just making stuff up to get rid of me!

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t believe you had the nerve to barge into my room to not only verbally assault me, but accuse me of such a heinous thing!

name: Emilia
dialog: Just get out of here! Or else I’ll call security!

name: Emilia
dialog: I already told you it’s not true!! What else do you want me to say?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Wh-Who cares if I’m not rich?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Are you happy now?! Are you satisfied that you’ve finally found something that you can use to bring me down?!

name: Emilia
dialog: So what if everything isn’t what it used to be?! It’s not my fault my parents were criminals!

name: Emilia
dialog: They left me to rot alone, leaving me with absolutely nothing!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Everything I knew, everything I grew up with, my whole world, it was gone in a flash!

name: Emilia
dialog: How was I supposed to do everything on my own, when I’d never been taught how to even take care of myself!?

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t even keep a job long enough to survive!	If I hadn’t done anything, I’d be living on the streets too!

name: Emilia
dialog: Do you seriously believe I’m the kind of person who just gives up?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I had to do whatever it took to get my life back, no matter how I got there!

name: Emilia
dialog: What else could I do if Camp Buddy was the only choice I had left…?

name: Emilia
dialog: I thought I belonged there… but I was wrong…

name: Emilia
dialog: What was I supposed to do, Yoshinori?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Show up in front of everyone and say I’m dirt poor and unskilled?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Is it wrong to want the life I used to have, where everyone at least saw me as someone who mattered… just for a while?

name: Emilia
dialog: Call me prideful or whatever you want, but my dignity is the only thing that made me fight when I had nothing else!

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s a load of crap!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ever since I got back, you all treated me as if I was the same child I was when we were scouts!

name: Emilia
dialog: Emilia’s a rich snob. Emilia’s annoying. Emilia’s a bitch! How could I be myself when you all judged and hated me from the start?!

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s the fucking problem, Yoshinori!!

name: Emilia
dialog: You were supposed to be the one who’d know better, but what did you do?!

name: Emilia
dialog: You rebuked me at every opportunity, thinking I’m nothing more than someone who’s out to hate everyone here!

name: Emilia
dialog: I thought you were different. I thought you accepted me for who I was. But you were just like everyone else!

name: Emilia
dialog: You said you were my friend, Yoshi!! You were the only one I had!

name: Emilia
dialog: I held on to that, but you forgot about me as soon as I left Camp Buddy!

name: Emilia
dialog: In nine years, not once did I get a call or a letter asking how I’ve been…!

name: Emilia
dialog: And when I got back here, you acted as if we barely knew each other…!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Just what kind of friend are you?!!

name: Emilia
dialog: I QUIT!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: You won’t hear anything from me or see me ever again, just like what you all wanted!

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s how it’s always been, and this time is no different!

name: Emilia
dialog: JUST LEAVE ME ALONE ALREADY!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Please… Yoshi… I’m begging you…

name: Emilia
dialog: *cries*

name: Emilia
dialog: Nnn…

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Huh…?

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp* Wh-Where am I?

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Have you… been taking care of me?

name: Emilia
dialog: I see…

name: Emilia
dialog: Everyone…? But I was— Wait…

name: Emilia
dialog: N-No! I… I shouldn’t be here anymore…!

name: Emilia
dialog: U-Ugh…!

name: Emilia
dialog: Wh-Why are you doing this…?

name: Emilia
dialog: Being nice to me. After everything I did…

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t understand… How can you forgive me just like that?

name: Emilia
dialog: I… really need to leave. I don’t belong here…

name: Emilia
dialog: I-It’s over for me…

name: Emilia
dialog: Wh-What...?

name: Emilia
dialog: Y-Yes…

name: Emilia
dialog: H-How did you get back up…?

name: Emilia
dialog: A-Ah…!!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m just feeling a little light-headed from too much sleep… But I’m fine now, really…

name: Emilia
dialog: W-Why are you apologizing…?

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t understand…

name: Emilia
dialog: You were all supposed to hate me for everything I’ve done… but instead you’re treating me like this…

name: Emilia
dialog: If anything, I should be the one apologizing… not only for my lies but also for causing you all trouble…

name: Emilia
dialog: I really can’t fathom how you could all let that go so easily, when I’ve done nothing but let my bitterness consume me…

name: Emilia
dialog: The expectations I had were so unreasonable, acting so entitled and then being so loathsome when things didn’t go my way…

name: Emilia
dialog: In a sense, I thought to myself that this place allowed me to return to what I used to be. But then, what I used to be was a horrible person to begin with…

name: Emilia
dialog: There’s just no excuse… I was so, so wrong…

name: Emilia
dialog: I… I’m really sorry…

name: Emilia
dialog: *cries*

name: Emilia
dialog: *sniff*

name: Emilia
dialog: *cries*

name: Emilia
dialog: *sniff* I-I owe you an apology the most, Aiden…

name: Emilia
dialog: It was so unfair that I projected all my insecurities towards you… You didn’t deserve to be treated like that...

name: Emilia
dialog: Just like Yoshinori, you’ve always been kind to me, and I exploited that to feel better about myself…

name: Emilia
dialog: Yoshinori was right to condemn me all those times he defended you, because everything I’ve been saying to and about you was just cruel and untrue…

name: Emilia
dialog: So, I’m really sorry…

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m just really ashamed… because what I just did earlier today made things a lot worse…

name: Emilia
dialog: And I don’t want you all to think that any of it is your fault…

name: Emilia
dialog: I couldn’t sleep last night… I was just thinking about everything that happened and what I’d done.

name: Emilia
dialog: I felt like it was tearing me apart, and I panicked and took a lot of my sleeping pills, hoping they would calm me down…

name: Emilia
dialog: I couldn’t remember anything much after that…

name: Emilia
dialog: I knew it was wrong… But at that moment, everything was dark and I felt like there was no way out for me…

name: Emilia
dialog: I was desperate to get out of the hole I was left in by my parents.

name: Emilia
dialog: I have no money, I have no home, and I could barely survive… I don’t even have a family to rely on.

name: Emilia
dialog: I have nothing left outside of Camp Buddy… This really was the last chance I had, yet I took it for granted by being so greedy and arrogant…

name: Emilia
dialog: I thought if I held myself to a high standard, that I’d be able to fit in and be someone important again.

name: Emilia
dialog: I know… I realize now that I let the wrong things define who I was, and it was my main drive for acting the way I did.

name: Emilia
dialog: I really don’t deserve all this kindness…

name: Emilia
dialog: I’ve used up all my chances and now I’m being given another one… I don’t know if I can trust myself to not make another mistake…

name: Emilia
dialog: I am. I don’t want to live like that anymore.

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s right! I am fierce! I won’t let this keep me down!

name: Emilia
dialog: I do want to turn my life around! And I’m not going to waste this chance!

name: Emilia
dialog: I will make up for everything, mark my words! And I—

name: Emilia
dialog: Thank you…

name: Emilia
dialog: Not only for taking care of me, but also for all the advice and understanding…

name: Emilia
dialog: I will. Thank you again.

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Huh? Y-You don’t have to…!

name: Emilia
dialog: *sigh*

name: Emilia
dialog: R-Right…

name: Emilia
dialog: *sigh* I guess I really thought people preferred the straightforwardness…

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I could have handled myself just fine, thank you very much…!

name: Emilia
dialog: Just so you know, I’m feeling a lot stronger already. I’d say I’m almost back to normal.

name: Emilia
dialog: Yuri here has been listening to me ramble all day.

name: Emilia
dialog: I hate to admit it, but she made really great points that made me realize the mistakes I made about how I come across to everyone.

name: Emilia
dialog: She’s an excellent counselor, I must say.

name: Emilia
dialog: Having someone to tell all my thoughts to is still new to me. It really does help.

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph, I doubt it! There’s no way I could deal with her strange hobbies and manic episodes!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hngh!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ugh… It’s about time she left.

name: Emilia
dialog: *sigh* Barely… I’m just trying my best to keep my cool.

name: Emilia
dialog: D-Don’t get me wrong, I am grateful for all her help.

name: Emilia
dialog: I was discussing with Yuri about moving forward… and that includes my position here at the camp.

name: Emilia
dialog: I really appreciate that you all gave me a bit of time to calm down and stay here until I recover…

name: Emilia
dialog: But I found out from Yuri that none of you told Mr. Clermont the issue about my credentials…

name: Emilia
dialog: I see…

name: Emilia
dialog: On that note, I was hoping to report my own mistakes to Mr. Clermont directly.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m well aware of the severity of the error I made, which is why I need to be terminated from my position so that I don’t negatively affect the project further.

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s just… I need to face the consequences of my actions.

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t want to live a lie anymore…

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp*

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I’m doing fine, sir.

name: Emilia
dialog: But I have something very important I need to discuss with you.

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s alright, Yoshi. It’s about time Mr. Clermont hears the truth.

name: Emilia
dialog: I regret to inform you my professional identity has been far from the truth, sir.

name: Emilia
dialog: To start with, I falsified my credentials to get the job as an inspector.

name: Emilia
dialog: In addition, I let my own personal issues with the other staff members here get in the way of progress, hindering the project multiple times.

name: Emilia
dialog: I am not qualified for the position and will be resigning effective immediately.

name: Emilia
dialog: I understand…

name: Emilia
dialog: Wh-What?!

name: Emilia
dialog: This is all so… overwhelming…

name: Emilia
dialog: Everyone is going out of their way to help me… even after everything I’ve done…

name: Emilia
dialog: The people I mistreated are the ones who saved me from what I thought was inevitable…

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I’m more than happy to accept and I’m nothing but grateful…!

name: Emilia
dialog: Everyone…

name: Emilia
dialog: W-Wait… before we leave… I really want to take this opportunity to properly thank you both…

name: Emilia
dialog: This is more than I could have ever hoped for, and I want to make sure the trust everyone placed in me is worth it.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m starting to rethink my decision about staying here…

name: Emilia
dialog: R-Really?

name: Emilia
dialog: At least you chose something that matches me.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’d say I’m impressed considering this is a cheap costume from the party store.

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s about time you got in costume too, Yoshi.

name: Emilia
dialog: It seems that Taiga and I have a lot in common, believe it or not.

name: Emilia
dialog: Exactly. But in my case, I’m just getting started.

name: Emilia
dialog: And you’re right that I’ve got to put in the work too.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m trying to think of ways to really show how much I’m willing to change…

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s still surreal though, you seem so calm and well-put together now for your age.

name: Emilia
dialog: I have a hard time imagining you being in a similar position as I was.

name: Emilia
dialog: Now I wonder what I’m going to be called from now on…

name: Emilia
dialog: Well, I’m not risking it. I’m staying here.

name: Emilia
dialog: Well, I don’t mind hearing more…! They always inspire me, believe it or not!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hey! Don’t blame me! You’re the one who forgot it!

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t know, ask this pink thing what’s grinding her gears!!

name: Emilia
dialog: For your information, I put it in your phone, and you left that too!

name: Emilia
dialog: And who in the world writes shopping lists on paper nowadays?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I told you all, I’m fine already! I’m not helpless!

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s only because I was hiding something. There’s no need to do that anymore~

name: Emilia
dialog: I suppose it was alright. I taught Yuri a thing or two about makeup since she clearly knows nothing.

name: Emilia
dialog: Don’t make it sound like you hated the idea… You’re the one who’s been going on about having a gal-pal, finally!

name: Emilia
dialog: You couldn’t stop showing me those fanfics of yours all night long!

name: Emilia
dialog: Yeah… I was confused at first, but I think I got the gist of it. But damn, you guys have no idea how much weird stuff this woman is into.

name: Emilia
dialog: I mean, they were fine, but not great when it’s ten chapters in one sitting!

name: Emilia
dialog: Oh, I actually know a nice foot spa recipe that’ll ease that right away! Add some cucumbers and a mud mask, and we’ll have a proper spa day!

name: Emilia
dialog: AAAAAH! What the hell?! Why are you all here?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I thought nobody was in here since the cabin was empty and the bathroom was unlocked…!

name: Emilia
dialog: Just for the record… What’s up with you guys’ room?! It totally reeks!

name: Emilia
dialog: It smells like sweat and protein shakes…! Try opening up a window!

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I’m here to get your dirty laundry.

name: Emilia
dialog: Eek!

name: Emilia
dialog: Goodness gracious… This is your used underwear! I think I’m gonna puke!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ugh… This is what my life has become…

name: Emilia
dialog: I asked Yuri to teach me to do some chores today. But ugh… I didn’t sign up for… this.

name: Emilia
dialog: She probably knew I would hate this one and took advantage of my initiative! That witch!

name: Emilia
dialog: You know, I should be flattered by that statement…

name: Emilia
dialog: But you saying that while you’re handing me your sweat-soaked shirt kinda ruins the mood.

name: Emilia
dialog: A-Anyway, I checked on Mr. Clermont a while ago and he’s already packing up to leave.

name: Emilia
dialog: I was going to send him off, but I still have to work on this laundry.

name: Emilia
dialog: AAAHHH, WHAT THE FUCK?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Yuri… I already broke a nail doing the laundry… Can I take a break from all of these menial jobs…?

name: Emilia
dialog: “It’S tHe sAmE jOb yOu wErE bAdMoUtHiNg BaCk ThEn” Fine, fine! I get it… geez…

name: Emilia
dialog: You’re not just in an apron today – what’s the occasion?

name: Emilia
dialog: I still don’t understand how you got away with being naked in the kitchen all those other times. I’m pretty sure that’s a sanitary code violation.

name: Emilia
dialog: Did you just make that up…?

name: Emilia
dialog: And how did you manage to pull that approval off with Aiden over here running around the camp? Did you hide him in the closet?

name: Emilia
dialog: G-Gah…!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s not like I have a choice… I’d much rather have a desk job than this.

name: Emilia
dialog: What?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m appalled to hear that you’d even consider turning it down!

name: Emilia
dialog: An opportunity as big as this is once in a lifetime!

name: Emilia
dialog: With someone of Mr. Clermont’s caliber, he’d really put your name out there!

name: Emilia
dialog: And that’s not even mentioning the money – you’d be pulling in almost five figures a month with the clientele he refers!

name: Emilia
dialog: *sigh* I remember when my bank account had a hundred thousand just as petty cash…

name: Emilia
dialog: After losing all that and having to live life so frugally, you really get to see what a difference it makes.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m not trying to be callous here, and I’m sure we all know, but Aiden has never really gotten to experience financial freedom.

name: Emilia
dialog: Now that you have the chance to change that, the decision here seems so obvious!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m a go-getter, so if I were in your shoes, I’d fight for that position!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m a go-getter, so if I were in your shoes, I’d fight for that position!{fast}

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s a JOB! It’s always about the money!

name: Emilia
dialog: You’re wasting time if you ask me~ If you don’t want it, teach me how to cook and I’ll gladly take your spot!

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Hey, let go of me!

name: Emilia
dialog: Tsk, tsk. Late, just like I expected…

name: Emilia
dialog: Scheduled or not, the management staff being the last ones to arrive is very telling.

name: Emilia
dialog: Whatever happened to this camp’s oath about being prepared for anything?

name: Emilia
dialog: I thought so.

name: Emilia
dialog: Of course! I’ve gathered you all here today to make a very IMPORTANT announcement regarding our productivity for the next few months.

name: Emilia
dialog: After my inspection and a meticulous review of everyone’s progress so far – I have worked overnight to create a detailed timetable for the next few months.

name: Emilia
dialog: This new schedule includes every deadline for each aspect of the project!

name: Emilia
dialog: Do note that these due dates are GENEROUSLY calculated, so I’m expecting nothing less than for everyone to STRICTLY follow the schedule.

name: Emilia
dialog: Here are the instructions for each department head.

name: Emilia
dialog: These folders contain each department’s tasks, concerns, and a reminder of how everything should be done. Make sure to read and follow the details carefully.

name: Emilia
dialog: Everything you need to know is in there, so I don’t want to hear any questions later.

name: Emilia
dialog: I also expect you all to take my evaluations from yesterday into account.

name: Emilia
dialog: Mr. Clermont has invested a LOT into this venture, so I’m sure we can all agree to show him nothing but the best.

name: Emilia
dialog: No hard feelings, it’s just business after all.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m sure if we all approach this with a positive attitude, we’ll achieve our collective goal. That’s what we all want, isn’t it?

name: Emilia
dialog: Now, for all the workers, grab a copy of the schedule here.

name: Emilia
dialog: Yes, it has come to my attention that the original timetable included a large unproductive break of several weeks.

name: Emilia
dialog: I think it would be a waste of time to stop, especially since we’ll have already built up our momentum by then.

name: Emilia
dialog: O-Of course I have! It’s my job to know all the details of the project after all!

name: Emilia
dialog: I only adjusted the schedule based on the issues that were made apparent to me yesterday during my survey!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s common sense to ensure that there is plenty of time at the tail-end of any project to allow for any setbacks, which was my main reason for the extended work period!

name: Emilia
dialog: But if you want to do it your way, then so be it.

name: Emilia
dialog: Just be prepared for stricter deadlines and less room for error!

name: Emilia
dialog: Excuse me?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I would have if I wasn’t so rudely interrupted.

name: Emilia
dialog: Anyway, I am left with no choice but to cede to the camp president’s decision, and will include this extensive break in our schedule.

name: Emilia
dialog: That means we need to get as much work done as possible before the season ends.

name: Emilia
dialog: Everyone should follow the instructions I’ve handed out today, but I will follow up with a revised schedule with STRICTER deadlines, as Mr. Nomoru requested.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’ll be checking on all of your progress at the end of the day. You’re all dismissed!

name: Emilia
dialog: Yoshinori.

name: Emilia
dialog: Come with me for a moment. I’d like to talk about something.

name: Emilia
dialog: Lovely weather we’re having today, aren’t we?

name: Emilia
dialog: Can you believe we have found ourselves again at the same place?

name: Emilia
dialog: If you had told the me from almost ten years ago, I wouldn’t have believed it.

name: Emilia
dialog: But I do have to say, it is somewhat comforting that this place is the same as it used to be, as unfortunate as that sounds.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’d always come to this spot so no one could find me, and I wouldn’t have to deal with other people.

name: Emilia
dialog: Every day I spent here was miserable. Everyone hated me for just saying things as they were.

name: Emilia
dialog: I know everyone was just jealous of my higher status, so the only thing they could do was to cast me out.

name: Emilia
dialog: Goodness gracious, I was getting there… Am I not allowed to set the mood?

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph! Since when did you become such a buzzkill?

name: Emilia
dialog: Well, I figured that since we’re going to work so closely for the next couple of months, it would be nice to start fresh and catch up, on a more personal level~!

name: Emilia
dialog: This is a huge project after all, you’re going to need my help!

name: Emilia
dialog: Think of it as me returning the favor. I don’t want to let an old friend down, after all.

name: Emilia
dialog: What…?!

name: Emilia
dialog: With that old man?

name: Emilia
dialog: So, you’re telling me you’re just going to let things run as they are, refusing any changes for the sake of the camp? My ears must be broken!

name: Emilia
dialog: And how can you grow and utilize your full potential as a future leader if you keep sitting on the sidelines?!

name: Emilia
dialog: The Yoshinori I know aspired for greater things, and not allowing himself to be bossed around so easily!

name: Emilia
dialog: Mr. Nomoru. Why did you adjust someone’s position in the camp without my knowledge?

name: Emilia
dialog: Yoshinori was supposed to be under my wing, not yours. That’s how I wrote it in the outline I gave everyone today.

name: Emilia
dialog: But I’m the manager here!

name: Emilia
dialog: Fine then.

name: Emilia
dialog: You should know this is the last time I’ll try and advocate for you, Yoshinori. Don’t come crying to me when something goes wrong later.

name: Emilia
dialog: At first I was baffled too, but hearing just how big of an undertaking it was… It might be too much for a small group of people like us…

name: Emilia
dialog: Hehe, that sounds about right~!

name: Emilia
dialog: I think that defeats the purpose. If Sir Goro sticks around, it would be in his nature to assist the camp in every way he can.

name: Emilia
dialog: He won’t be able to have time for himself if that’s the case.

name: Emilia
dialog: Calm down, Yuri… It’s not like they’re dying.

name: Emilia
dialog: Well, I have nowhere else to be anyway… and Aiden’s gonna need all the help he can get!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’ve grown quite fond of this place, after all.  And I’m even adjusting to a simpler life!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph, I don’t see you complaining whenever I let you wear them!

name: Emilia
dialog: I suppose I could whip us something up~

name: Emilia
dialog: At first I was baffled too, but hearing just how big of an undertaking it was… It might be too much for a small group of people like us…

name: Emilia
dialog: WHAT?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Th-This is news to me!

name: Emilia
dialog: Wait a minute, Yoshinori!

name: Emilia
dialog: Show me your hand!

name: Emilia
dialog: NO WAY…! That’s a real diamond!! Embedded on a titanium band too!

name: Emilia
dialog: Duh! I can sense bougie jewelry from a mile away! Real diamonds have a distinct sparkle to them that really catches the eye!

name: Emilia
dialog: Looks good on you, though~ Since when did you become interested in—

name: Emilia
dialog: Wait a minute… YOU DIDN’T—

name: Emilia
dialog: SIR GORO!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Are you serious? They’ve been literally inseparable since we started the project, wasn’t that enough of a sign for you?

name: Emilia
dialog: Yuri! What the hell are you doing?! I’ve been waiting for half an hour!

name: Emilia
dialog: Oh~? Don’t you mean with ‘Dad’ and ‘Dad’?

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s true though~ When are you gonna make her call you that, Yoshi?

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Hey! Where do you think you’re going?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Can somebody tell me what’s going on?

name: Emilia
dialog: Yuri’s sitting way over here on the verge of choking, and you’re all talking like there’s an inside joke.

name: Emilia
dialog: Yeah, lighten up, will you?! We literally finished the project; you should be celebrating!

name: Emilia
dialog: Go on, tell the poor fool, he’s close to tears.

name: Emilia
dialog: What? You don’t want them to stay?! Isn’t this what you’ve been tearing up about for the past two minutes?

name: Emilia
dialog: As for me, I’m going to stick with the helper role.

name: Emilia
dialog: No… I noticed during my time as both an inspector and these last few months that Aiden does all the maintenance work by himself, both during the on and off season.

name: Emilia
dialog: I… want to help alleviate some of his workload so he can focus more on what he’s really passionate about, cooking.

name: Emilia
dialog: Plus, doing chores over the last few months has been strangely… enjoyable.

name: Emilia
dialog: I never experienced them growing up, and always was disgusted by ‘dirty work.’

name: Emilia
dialog: Now, I feel a real sense of fulfilment when I complete them, seeing everyone enjoy the comfort as a direct result of my hard work.

name: Emilia
dialog: Not to mention that I’m learning new skills as well.

name: Emilia
dialog: And obviously, I had plenty of prep work to do before hand – looking this good takes time after all~

name: Emilia
dialog: So? We’re not exactly at the fanciest of venues here! A little delay won’t hurt anything!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ahhhh, this just gets me thinking about how differently I’D do my wedding~

name: Emilia
dialog: A fancy hotel on a private island… Or maybe on the top of a beautiful mountain?

name: Emilia
dialog: Oh! Or maybe—

name: Emilia
dialog: Ah, it’s so nice to see this new part of our camp in full bloom. I feel like a proud mother seeing all my plants grow so prettily~

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s so hard to believe that we’ve been doing absolutely nothing for the past few weeks… considering how full our hands were for over half a year.

name: Emilia
dialog: Summer is right around the corner, though. The scouts will be coming back soon.

name: Emilia
dialog: Honestly, I’m eager to meet the scouts. I’ll definitely give them a proper introduction.

name: Emilia
dialog: But they’d better not get on my bad side.

name: Emilia
dialog: Speaking of which… looks like some people really can’t wait for summer.

name: Emilia
dialog: Speaking of Sir Goro… When are he and Yoshi going to be back?

name: Emilia
dialog: How come those two are allowed to go on dates and we’re not?!

name: Emilia
dialog: What?! So, you’re telling me I could’ve been out on a vacation instead of digging up soil and weeding for weeks?!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s because I thought there was nothing else to do! I’ve been scammed!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hey, don’t change the subject! We need to go on a vacation too!

name: Emilia
dialog: If that’s the case, then pack your bags, Yuri! We’re going to see that new ‘JS’ movie!

name: Emilia
dialog: Speaking of Sir Goro… where are he and Yoshi?! I haven’t seen them today.

name: Emilia
dialog: Going out would be the best thing to do with so much free time.

name: Emilia
dialog: Sure, I think I’ve finished all the chores for the day. Turns out they aren’t so bad when nobody is around.

name: Emilia
dialog: You said you heard from him right, Yuri?

name: Emilia
dialog: Come on, let’s get you inside. We can watch a nice movie and get it off our minds.

name: Emilia
dialog: Thank you for bringing this up, Mr. Clermont. I believe these matters are of utmost importance.

name: Emilia
dialog: As the standing representative for quality assurance, I wanted to discuss some specific departmental concerns that need to be corrected.

name: Emilia
dialog: Let’s start off with Mr. Choi. I’ve found his reversed sleep schedule to be very unprofessional.

name: Emilia
dialog: He sleeps the whole day starting from 9:00 am until 6:00 pm which are the peak productivity hours. There was no way for me to reach him in-person to oversee his work.

name: Emilia
dialog: Even so, it would’ve been optimal if he were accessible in the same time frame as everyone else. Not to mention that it’s a potential health concern.

name: Emilia
dialog: Moving on to the construction department, I have noticed inconsistencies with the time cards of Mr. Sirius and Mr. Najjar.

name: Emilia
dialog: From my observations, it was mostly due to the unnecessarily extensive morning routines they partake in.

name: Emilia
dialog: Moving forward, I suggest skipping these nonsense leisure activities and using your spare time to contribute to the project, considering we’re in crunch time.

name: Emilia
dialog: Which brings me to another issue: Ms. Nomoru’s attitude problem. She’s very hostile towards me, as you can see.

name: Emilia
dialog: And you, Mr. Flynn! You continue to exhibit indecent and explicit behavior around the camp despite my previous warnings!

name: Emilia
dialog: This leads to distractions that only causes more time lost on the project!

name: Emilia
dialog: And last but not least, Mr. Nagira.

name: Emilia
dialog: You and Mr. Nomoru completely disregarded the plan I had laid out, repeatedly performing tasks out of your scope like headless chickens.

name: Emilia
dialog: You refused to follow the schedule I made to maximize efficiency only to blindly obey the whims of the camp president!

name: Emilia
dialog: You refused to follow the schedule I made to maximize efficiency only to blindly obey the whims of the camp president!{fast}

name: Emilia
dialog: That doesn’t change the fact that you two have purposefully kept me out of the loop, all because you’re incapable of taking action without someone telling you what to do!

name: Emilia
dialog: What? How dare y—

name: Emilia
dialog: Personal?! I’m the only one who’s been professional here!

name: Emilia
dialog: Shouldn’t you know better than anyone as the camp’s leader that business is no place for emotional attachment?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I… Well—

name: Emilia
dialog: Mr. Clermont, please allow me to explain—

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph!

name: Emilia
dialog: What?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Seriously?! After you kept your mouth shut and let everyone gang up on me back there, you still have the nerve to attack me like this?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Understand me?! I tried to get back in touch with you from the start, and you never once reciprocated!

name: Emilia
dialog: Here I was trying my hardest to help you and this stupid camp, but you didn’t think twice about humiliating me in front of everyone!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m just doing my job! It’s not my fault that none of you can accept how wrong you all are!

name: Emilia
dialog: Everyone kept cowering behind that sorry excuse for a leader who just keeps abusing his power!

name: Emilia
dialog: Go ahead, keep licking his boots! That’s all you’ve ever done!

name: Emilia
dialog: You know what, I’m done with you, Yoshinori.

name: Emilia
dialog: And I thought you were my friend...

name: Emilia
dialog: You’ve changed.

name: Emilia
dialog: Don’t talk to me.

name: Emilia
dialog: *facepalms* Eugh…

name: Emilia
dialog: Hnghhh…!! Why in the world is no one helping me with my luggage?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Don’t bother. There are people here paid to be doing this.

name: Emilia
dialog: What kind of service does this place have!? A bellboy should have helped me with my bags the moment we got off that shuttle!

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t believe no one welcomed me either, do they even know who sent us here?! Where’s my room?! I thought this was a five-star luxury hotel?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I want to speak with the manager!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ugh! It’s about time!

name: Emilia
dialog: Finally. Something closer to home.

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph, bold of you to assume I want to share a room with the likes of you!

name: Emilia
dialog: *snatches keys*

name: Emilia
dialog: Just like at the camp, I require my own room, thank you very much.

name: Emilia
dialog: I hate to stay and listen to your pointless bickering, so I’d best be on my way.

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp*

name: Emilia
dialog: Goodness fucking gracious! How dare you sneak up on me like that!

name: Emilia
dialog: What the hell do you want?

name: Emilia
dialog: Now all of a sudden you’re interested? It’s none of your business. Leave me alone.

name: Emilia
dialog: For your information, I was having a good time before you came along.

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t need other people to enjoy a vacation! Especially now that I’m finally in a place up to my standards.

name: Emilia
dialog: Would you stop that already?!

name: Emilia
dialog: You know what you’re doing! You’re acting like that goody-two-shoes scout that pretends to care about everything!

name: Emilia
dialog: I know better now than to get tricked by fake people like you!

name: Emilia
dialog: If you came here to ruin my oh-so-perfect-day. Congratulations, you just did.

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t believe you served me something raw! Touch this meat and tell me that’s not just taken straight out of the fridge!

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I knew that! But I’m not trying to get salmonella on my vacation, is that too hard to understand?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I didn’t come here to eat something that common! Now, cook this meat up before I sue this entire place!

name: Emilia
dialog: *sigh* Can’t even have a good time around here…

name: Emilia
dialog: Are you just going to stand over there and pretend I didn’t see you?

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph! If you assumed I needed you or anyone’s help then you’re sorely mistaken.

name: Emilia
dialog: You have the nerve to tell me that? Don’t tell me how I should spend my time!

name: Emilia
dialog: None of you invited me anyway, so why should I bother squeezing myself into a group who doesn’t give a damn in the first place?

name: Emilia
dialog: I’d rather be alone than spend my precious time pretending to be friends with people like you.

name: Emilia
dialog: What?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Who are we kidding here, Yoshinori? I hate all of you, and you all hate me. There’s no secret there.

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s nowhere close to what I’m used to.

name: Emilia
dialog: You know I have high standards, considering I get way better food, service and atmosphere at home than at this mediocre hotel!

name: Emilia
dialog: But don’t get me wrong, this is far more bearable than having to stay in that raggedy camp.

name: Emilia
dialog: GRAH! Why are you suddenly probing me about all of this?! As if I needed one more person to keep scrutinizing everything I do!

name: Emilia
dialog: This is exactly why I wanted to be alone in the first place!

name: Emilia
dialog: Everything here is primitive and disgusting! And the commoners here make me sick!

name: Emilia
dialog: Surely there was a better option than this trashy camp! At the very least you could’ve let me stay at home alone!

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t stand being here for another minute! Why did you even send me here?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I know that you’re out of the country! Shouldn’t I have gone with you?!

name: Emilia
dialog: You’re always leaving me behind! And all you and Dad ever do is scold me when you’re around!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s like you don’t even care about me! You’re the worst—

name: Emilia
dialog: Did you really send me here just to punish me?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I don’t need strangers giving me useless life lessons!

name: Emilia
dialog: Wh-What…?! N-No! You can’t do that!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Mom, please!! Don’t leave me here!

name: Emilia
dialog: I—

name: Emilia
dialog: GRAHHH!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: *throws phone on the ground*

name: Emilia
dialog: Stupid camp! Stupid parents! Stupid everything!!

name: Emilia
dialog: How long have you been standing there?! Were you spying on me?!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s none of your business! And don’t you dare tell anyone what you’ve heard!

name: Emilia
dialog: You’re just gonna use that to get me in trouble, aren’t you?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Shut up! Just leave me alone like everyone else!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: MAKE WAY! MAKE WAY! The queen of the night has arrived!

name: Emilia
dialog: Well?! Not even one compliment? I didn’t put on a lovely dress just to be ignored!

name: Emilia
dialog: *chuckles* I know~

name: Emilia
dialog: I was pleasantly surprised to find out Mr. Clermont arranged a fine dining experience for us tonight! Truly such a treat~!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s been a hot minute since my last one! But better late than never!

name: Emilia
dialog: Why of course I brought my own attire!

name: Emilia
dialog: Dress to impress, after all! I wouldn’t be caught dead wearing a free tacky dress, unlike someone~

name: Emilia
dialog: No, thank you! Like they say, beauty is pain~

name: Emilia
dialog: The gown? Cucci! The feather? Verse-ace! The shoes? Louis Butt-on! The jewelry? Stiffany & Ho!

name: Emilia
dialog: All custom made for me!

name: Emilia
dialog: Teehee~ It’s no surprise anyone would be jealous. I mean… who wouldn’t be over someone like me?

name: Emilia
dialog: Now! Where are we supposed to sit? Shouldn’t we be getting served right about now?

name: Emilia
dialog: WAITER!

name: Emilia
dialog: You! Aren’t you gonna show us our table?! Don’t you know that we’re VIP guests here?!

name: Emilia
dialog: That should’ve been obvious upon my arrival! Now, show me to the best seat in here!

name: Emilia
dialog: Kindly exclude me from that list. I’m very much used to this kind of setting.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’ve taken special lessons on fine dining etiquette from a young age, after all~

name: Emilia
dialog: You should know there’s a secret language of the napkin that comes in handy when you need to excuse yourself from the table~

name: Emilia
dialog: Leaving it on your chair will signal to the waiter that you’re not done with your meal, while leaving it neatly on the left-hand side of your plate will inform the waiter to clear your plate!

name: Emilia
dialog: Since it sounds like everyone’s not that willing to learn, you can all just watch what I’m doing and follow~

name: Emilia
dialog: Those are just the mere basics, though~ There are a lot more to consider especially once the meal has been served!

name: Emilia
dialog: For example, did you know you’re not supposed to blow on your food to cool it off?  You’re supposed to wait at least a minute to let it cool down!

name: Emilia
dialog: Pacing your eating is just as essential too! Smaller bites are encouraged even if it takes longer!

name: Emilia
dialog: And it’s very important to taste everything on your plate, even if you’re unsure you’ll like it!

name: Emilia
dialog: Oh, and don’t forget noisy chewing and lip-smacking. That’s just disgustingly barbaric.

name: Emilia
dialog: But that’s what I was sayi—

name: Emilia
dialog: Why, there’s no need for that~ I’ve had plenty of experience with fine dining establishments, and I know exactly what I want!

name: Emilia
dialog: For an appetizer, I’ll have the smoked salmon crostini with herbed mayo— Actually, hold the mayo, and use pesto instead~

name: Emilia
dialog: For the main course, give me the petit beef wellington, obviously it had better be made with filet mignon and hand-kneaded puff pastry.

name: Emilia
dialog: Medium RARE, oh, and don’t overdo it. Trust me, I’ll know.

name: Emilia
dialog: Lastly, for dessert… I’ll keep it simple. I’ll have a vanilla crème brulee topped with fresh blueberries and a dash of raspberry coulis.

name: Emilia
dialog: First timers, am I right?

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s bouillabaisse my dear, it’s a good thing I’m here. If anyone needs help with the menu, I don’t mind educating you~

name: Emilia
dialog: Pardon my intrusion, but I can’t help but overhear some of your selections… Allow me to offer some valuable advice.

name: Emilia
dialog: For the main, the superior choice is obviously the slow roasted pork belly~ Flavorful and hearty.

name: Emilia
dialog: Mr. Sirius, if you prefer seafood with a higher price point, then the choice for you is lobster bisque! Black truffle dal for Mr. Najjar. And saffron chicken paella for everyone else~

name: Emilia
dialog: As for the appetizers—

name: Emilia
dialog: Goodness gracious, I can’t believe all of you wasted your opportunity to order something more sophisticated.

name: Emilia
dialog: Instead, you all let just one person decide everything. And he didn’t even choose appetizers and desserts!

name: Emilia
dialog: Excuse me, there’s no need to be so rude. I’ve just been trying to share my knowledge ever since we sat down.

name: Emilia
dialog: Because quite frankly, you all looked like you could use some guidance.

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s not the issue here, the problem is that none of my suggestions are even considered, while everyone just agrees to whatever Mr. Nomoru says.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m only trying to prove my point. Do I look upset to you?

name: Emilia
dialog: Argue? I was trying to help. You’re all twisting the narrative on me.

name: Emilia
dialog: A-About time…!

name: Emilia
dialog: Simpletons! These are just the appetizers! They’re supposed to be small!

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s the point! It’s meant to stimulate your senses, to build up your appetite for the main course!

name: Emilia
dialog: And you’re not supposed to shove it down your throat and swallow it like a pill! You’re ruining the experience!

name: Emilia
dialog: Look at how it’s done! I sliced mine into four equal parts, making sure each part has every ingredient, allowing me to savor each bite!

name: Emilia
dialog: If only everyone had listened to my recommendations, then you wouldn’t have missed out~

name: Emilia
dialog: My goodness, did we not just have a conversation about table manners? Stop talking when your mouth is full.

name: Emilia
dialog: How am I supposed to with all of you talking over each other like you’ve never seen food on a plate before?

name: Emilia
dialog: Excuse me, I’m doing exactly as I should. Unlike some of you who can’t even keep their elbows off the table.

name: Emilia
dialog: What…?

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m the one spoiling the mood?! Preposterous!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’ve only been trying to participate the conversation and you all shut me down at every chance.

name: Emilia
dialog: Am I not allowed to have an opinion? How come when I’m the one talking all of you always assume that I have ill intentions?

name: Emilia
dialog: You know what? There’s no point explaining myself to people who won’t even bother to listen!

name: Emilia
dialog: W-What…?

name: Emilia
dialog: What gives you the right to kick me out?

name: Emilia
dialog: First of all, we’re not at camp, and second of all, even if we were, you’re in no position to boss me around!

name: Emilia
dialog: This is exactly your problem. Just because you have some title, you think you can abuse your power and dictate for everyone what they can and can’t do!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s one thing when it’s work-related, but it’s entirely another when you force everyone into a situation where they’re not even allowed to think for themselves!

name: Emilia
dialog: So, you’re saying that I don’t?

name: Emilia
dialog: No, no. Let’s talk about it, since she’s questioning my abilities.

name: Emilia
dialog: I think I’ve proven how skilled I am over the last few months with actual results.

name: Emilia
dialog: Without me, your whole project wouldn’t have gotten this far, and we wouldn’t be sitting here enjoying this lovely dinner.

name: Emilia
dialog: I cannot believe what I’m hearing! You’re all just trying to discredit me, just like you did in that meeting!

name: Emilia
dialog: If anything, all of you just can’t accept honest criticism!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s awfully convenient for all of you to point at me for your own shortcomings, isn’t it?

name: Emilia
dialog: Why has nobody pointed out that we have an outdated leader who built this franchise up, then ran it into the ground?!

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s no secret that the reason the other branches of Camp Buddy closed down was because of his mismanagement!

name: Emilia
dialog: And yet we’re supposed to believe that following the same leadership would make a difference?

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s pretty telling how incompetent the one in charge really is when the only thing that saved the camp from disgrace... was the scouts.

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s another thing!  The only reason you have the nerve to constantly insult me is because your father lets you get away with all of it!

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t believe this blatant bias went on for years!  Your confrontational behavior and all your frivolous whims in and out of the camp just shows how hopelessly unprofessional you are!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph! Speaking of which, Yoshinori… you’re the prime example of someone who has been corrupted for so many years.

name: Emilia
dialog: You continue to let yourself be held down and waste your potential, keeping yourself and the camp from a better future.

name: Emilia
dialog: In fact, you all wouldn’t even need a sponsorship if it wasn’t for how badly you handled last year’s scandal and ruined the camp’s reputation!

name: Emilia
dialog: You should’ve known better than to be so passive and ingratiating – always crawling back to someone you look up to, all because you lack the spine to make your own choices!

name: Emilia
dialog: Why am I not surprised that your solution to everything is to just cut it off?

name: Emilia
dialog: You’re doing it to me, you did it to your scouts and staff, and you did it with your wife.

name: Emilia
dialog: I bet when you eventually don’t get your way with Yoshinori, you’ll cut him off just the same.

name: Emilia
dialog: This is why nobody stays in your life. Except maybe for your daughter, because you know what? She doesn’t really have much of a choice.

name: Emilia
dialog: Do the right thing for once, and keep everyone else out of your midlife crisis!

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp* Take that back!

name: Emilia
dialog: *throws wine at Goro*

name: Emilia
dialog: Go on! I dare you!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph… And so, we see his true colors.

name: Emilia
dialog: What? I’m the one who was verbally assaulted here!

name: Emilia
dialog: Maybe all of you shouldn’t have been so rude, then none of this would’ve happened!

name: Emilia
dialog: Fine! I never wanted to be here anyway!

name: Emilia
dialog: So, you’re saying we're stuck here?! This is unacceptable!

name: Emilia
dialog: I want to speak to the manager!

name: Emilia
dialog: Don’t you know how much is at stake by keeping us locked up in here?! We’re already behind schedule with our project!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ugh! I wouldn’t be surprised if this was just a ploy to force us into paying for another night!

name: Emilia
dialog: Where do you think we’ll get the money to pay for something outrageous like this?!

name: Emilia
dialog: You can’t talk to a VIP guest like this!

name: Emilia
dialog: Just you wait until the owner of this establishment gets the letter I’ll be writing! I’ll make sure all the incompetent staff like you are fired!

name: Emilia
dialog: Y-You should’ve said that sooner, then!

name: Emilia
dialog: And what about my bags?! You’re not expecting me to carry them back all the way to the top floor again, are you?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph!

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp*

name: Emilia
dialog: I didn’t order any room service! Leave me alone!

name: Emilia
dialog: Y-Yoshi? What are you doing here? What do you want?

name: Emilia
dialog: Well, let’s talk somewhere else. Give me just a bit to get ready.

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Huh…? What is this about?

name: Emilia
dialog: Look, I’m not in the mood for more preaching if that’s what you’re here for.

name: Emilia
dialog: So, leave me alone and get lo—

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp*

name: Emilia
dialog: W-What the hell do you want from me…?!

name: Emilia
dialog: What…?

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t know what you’re talking about! Wh-Who told you all of this?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Of course not! I can’t believe that you’re accusing me of such things! Whoever told that to you is probably just making stuff up to get rid of me!

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t believe you had the nerve to barge into my room to not only verbally assault me, but accuse me of such a heinous thing!

name: Emilia
dialog: Just get out of here! Or else I’ll call security!

name: Emilia
dialog: I already told you it’s not true!! What else do you want me to say?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Wh-Who cares if I’m not rich?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Are you happy now?! Are you satisfied that you’ve finally found something that you can use to bring me down?!

name: Emilia
dialog: So what if everything isn’t what it used to be?! It’s not my fault my parents were criminals!

name: Emilia
dialog: They left me to rot alone, leaving me with absolutely nothing!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Everything I knew, everything I grew up with, my whole world, it was gone in a flash!

name: Emilia
dialog: How was I supposed to do everything on my own, when I’d never been taught how to even take care of myself!?

name: Emilia
dialog: I can’t even keep a job long enough to survive!	If I hadn’t done anything, I’d be living on the streets too!

name: Emilia
dialog: Do you seriously believe I’m the kind of person who just gives up?!

name: Emilia
dialog: I had to do whatever it took to get my life back, no matter how I got there!

name: Emilia
dialog: What else could I do if Camp Buddy was the only choice I had left…?

name: Emilia
dialog: I thought I belonged there… but I was wrong…

name: Emilia
dialog: What was I supposed to do, Yoshinori?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Show up in front of everyone and say I’m dirt poor and unskilled?!

name: Emilia
dialog: Is it wrong to want the life I used to have, where everyone at least saw me as someone who mattered… just for a while?

name: Emilia
dialog: Call me prideful or whatever you want, but my dignity is the only thing that made me fight when I had nothing else!

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s a load of crap!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ever since I got back, you all treated me as if I was the same child I was when we were scouts!

name: Emilia
dialog: Emilia’s a rich snob. Emilia’s annoying. Emilia’s a bitch! How could I be myself when you all judged and hated me from the start?!

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s the fucking problem, Yoshinori!!

name: Emilia
dialog: You were supposed to be the one who’d know better, but what did you do?!

name: Emilia
dialog: You rebuked me at every opportunity, thinking I’m nothing more than someone who’s out to hate everyone here!

name: Emilia
dialog: I thought you were different. I thought you accepted me for who I was. But you were just like everyone else!

name: Emilia
dialog: You said you were my friend, Yoshi!! You were the only one I had!

name: Emilia
dialog: I held on to that, but you forgot about me as soon as I left Camp Buddy!

name: Emilia
dialog: In nine years, not once did I get a call or a letter asking how I’ve been…!

name: Emilia
dialog: And when I got back here, you acted as if we barely knew each other…!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Just what kind of friend are you?!!

name: Emilia
dialog: I QUIT!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: You won’t hear anything from me or see me ever again, just like what you all wanted!

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s how it’s always been, and this time is no different!

name: Emilia
dialog: JUST LEAVE ME ALONE ALREADY!!!

name: Emilia
dialog: Please… Yoshi… I’m begging you…

name: Emilia
dialog: *cries*

name: Emilia
dialog: Nnn…

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Huh…?

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp* Wh-Where am I?

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Have you… been taking care of me?

name: Emilia
dialog: Y-Yuri…? I see…

name: Emilia
dialog: Everyone…? But I was— Wait…

name: Emilia
dialog: N-No! I… I shouldn’t be here anymore…!

name: Emilia
dialog: U-Ugh…!

name: Emilia
dialog: Wh-Why are you doing this…?

name: Emilia
dialog: …I thought you didn’t want me here anymore.

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t understand… Why would you apologize just like that…?

name: Emilia
dialog: Even after everything I did…

name: Emilia
dialog: I… really need to leave. I don’t belong here…

name: Emilia
dialog: Nowhere… I-It’s over for me…

name: Emilia
dialog: D-don’t pity me! I… I don’t need sympathy…

name: Emilia
dialog: A-Ah…!!

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m just feeling a little light-headed from too much sleep… But I’m fine now, really…

name: Emilia
dialog: W-Why are you apologizing…?

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t understand…

name: Emilia
dialog: You were all supposed to hate me for everything I’ve done… but instead you’re treating me like this…

name: Emilia
dialog: If anything, I should be the one apologizing… not only for my lies but also for causing you all trouble…

name: Emilia
dialog: I really can’t fathom how you could all let that go so easily, when I’ve done nothing but let my bitterness consume me…

name: Emilia
dialog: The expectations I had were so unreasonable, acting so entitled and then being so loathsome when things didn’t go my way…

name: Emilia
dialog: In a sense, I thought to myself that this place allowed me to return to what I used to be. But then, what I used to be was a horrible person to begin with…

name: Emilia
dialog: There’s just no excuse… I was so, so wrong…

name: Emilia
dialog: I… I’m really sorry…

name: Emilia
dialog: *cries*

name: Emilia
dialog: *sniff*

name: Emilia
dialog: *cries*

name: Emilia
dialog: *sniff* I-I owe you an apology the most, Sir Goro…

name: Emilia
dialog: You were only doing your job as the leader of the camp, and all I did was let my prejudice take over – intentionally pushing your buttons every chance I got…

name: Emilia
dialog: Just like Yoshinori, you’ve been as tolerant as possible with my behavior, given how I deliberately tested everyone’s patience…

name: Emilia
dialog: Even when I was a scout here, you always handled me with compassion regardless of my immaturity…

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s all I wanted from my parents, and I see now that I took it for granted even here…

name: Emilia
dialog: So, I’m really sorry…

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m just really ashamed… because what I just did earlier today made things a lot worse…

name: Emilia
dialog: And I don’t want you all to think that any of it is your fault…

name: Emilia
dialog: I couldn’t sleep last night… I was just thinking about everything that happened and what I’d done.

name: Emilia
dialog: I felt like it was tearing me apart, and I panicked and took a lot of my sleeping pills, hoping they would calm me down…

name: Emilia
dialog: I couldn’t remember anything much after that…

name: Emilia
dialog: I knew it was wrong… But at that moment, everything was dark and I felt like there was no way out for me…

name: Emilia
dialog: I was desperate to get out of the hole I was left in by my parents.

name: Emilia
dialog: I have no money, I have no home, and I could barely survive… I don’t even have a family to rely on.

name: Emilia
dialog: I have nothing left outside of Camp Buddy… This really was the last chance I had, yet I took it for granted by being so greedy and arrogant…

name: Emilia
dialog: I thought if I held myself to a high standard, that I’d be able to fit in and be someone important again.

name: Emilia
dialog: I know… I realize now that I let the wrong things define who I was, and it was my main drive for acting the way I did.

name: Emilia
dialog: I really don’t deserve all this kindness…

name: Emilia
dialog: I’ve used up all my chances and now I’m being given another one… I don’t know if I can trust myself to not make another mistake…

name: Emilia
dialog: I am. I don’t want to live like that anymore.

name: Emilia
dialog: That’s right! I am fierce! I won’t let this keep me down!

name: Emilia
dialog: I do want to turn my life around! And I’m not going to waste this chance!

name: Emilia
dialog: I will make up for everything, mark my words! And I—

name: Emilia
dialog: Thank you…

name: Emilia
dialog: Not only for taking care of me, but also for all the advice and understanding…

name: Emilia
dialog: I will. Thank you again.

name: Emilia
dialog: H-Huh? Y-You don’t have to…!

name: Emilia
dialog: *sigh*

name: Emilia
dialog: R-Right…

name: Emilia
dialog: *sigh* I guess I really thought people preferred the straightforwardness…

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I could have handled myself just fine, thank you very much…!

name: Emilia
dialog: Just so you know, I’m feeling a lot stronger already. I’d say I’m almost back to normal.

name: Emilia
dialog: Yuri here has been listening to me ramble all day.

name: Emilia
dialog: I hate to admit it, but she made really great points that made me realize the mistakes I made about how I come across to everyone.

name: Emilia
dialog: She’s an excellent counselor, I must say.

name: Emilia
dialog: Having someone to tell all my thoughts to is still new to me. It really does help.

name: Emilia
dialog: Hmph, I doubt it! There’s no way I could deal with her strange hobbies and manic episodes!

name: Emilia
dialog: Hngh!

name: Emilia
dialog: Ugh… It’s about time she left.

name: Emilia
dialog: *sigh* Barely… I’m just trying my best to keep my cool.

name: Emilia
dialog: D-Don’t get me wrong, I am grateful for all her help.

name: Emilia
dialog: I was discussing with Yuri about moving forward… and that includes my position here at the camp.

name: Emilia
dialog: I really appreciate that you all gave me a bit of time to calm down and stay here until I recover…

name: Emilia
dialog: But I found out from Yuri that none of you told Mr. Clermont the issue about my credentials…

name: Emilia
dialog: I see…

name: Emilia
dialog: On that note, I was hoping to report my own mistakes to Mr. Clermont directly.

name: Emilia
dialog: I’m well aware of the severity of the error I made, which is why I need to be terminated from my position so that I don’t negatively affect the project further.

name: Emilia
dialog: It’s just… I need to face the consequences of my actions.

name: Emilia
dialog: I don’t want to live a lie anymore…

name: Emilia
dialog: *gasp*

name: Emilia
dialog: I-I’m doing fine, sir.

name: Emilia
dialog: But I have something very important I need to discuss with you.

name: Emilia
